ko.title: [마케팅 101 #10] 광고, 쿠폰, 영업사원이 모두 같은 이야기를 해야 하는 이유

segments.src: > Promotion isn't just advertising — it's four different tools (advertising, PR, sales promotion, personal selling) that work best when they say one consistent thing.
segments.tr: > 판촉은 단순한 광고가 아니라 네 가지 다른 도구(광고, 공중관계, 판매촉진, 개인판매)로 이루어지며, 이들이 일관된 메시지를 전달할 때 가장 효과적입니다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Promotion is the "P" that handles communication.
segments.tr: 판촉은 의사소통을 담당하는 "P"입니다.

segments.src: You've built a product, priced it, and put it somewhere people can buy it.
segments.tr: 제품을 만들고 가격을 정했으며 사람들이 구매할 수 있는 곳에 배치했습니다.

segments.src: None of that matters if nobody knows about it, believes it, or has a reason to act this month instead of someday.
segments.tr: 하지만 아무도 그것을 알지 못하거나 믿지 않거나 언젠가 대신 이번 달에 행동할 이유가 없다면 모든 것이 의미가 없습니다.

segments.src: Marketers usually break promotion into four classic tools, each with a different job:
segments.tr: 마케터들은 일반적으로 판촉을 네 가지 전통적인 도구로 나누는데, 각각 다른 역할을 합니다:

segments.src: Advertising** — paid, non-personal messaging from an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: 광고** — 특정 스폰서로부터의 유료, 비인격적 메시징.

segments.src: A streaming-service ad break, a billboard on I-95, a sponsored search result.
segments.tr: 스트리밍 서비스 광고 중단, I-95의 옥외광고, 후원된 검색 결과.

segments.src: Strength: it reaches enormous numbers of people cheaply *per person*, and you control the message word for word.
segments.tr: 강점: 인당 비용이 저렴하게 막대한 수의 사람들에게 도달하며, 메시지를 정확히 제어할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Weakness: it's one-way, easy to ignore, and audiences discount it because they know you paid for it.
segments.tr: 약점: 일방향이고 무시하기 쉬우며, 청중은 당신이 돈을 지불했다는 것을 알기 때문에 신뢰도를 깎아냅니다.

segments.src: Public relations (PR)** — earning favorable attention rather than buying placement.
segments.tr: 공중관계(PR)** — 게재 비용을 지불하는 대신 호의적인 관심을 얻기.

segments.src: Press outreach, founder interviews, community sponsorships, crisis response.
segments.tr: 언론 홍보, 창업자 인터뷰, 지역사회 스폰서십, 위기 대응.

segments.src: Strength: high credibility, because a reporter or a neighbor said it, not your ad copy.
segments.tr: 강점: 높은 신뢰도. 기자나 이웃이 말했기 때문에 당신의 광고 카피가 아닙니다.

segments.src: Weakness: you don't control it.
segments.tr: 약점: 당신이 제어할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: PR isn't free — you pay staff and agencies — you just can't guarantee the outcome.
segments.tr: PR은 무료가 아닙니다. 직원과 대행사에 돈을 지불합니다. 다만 결과를 보장할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: Sales promotion** — short-term incentives to trigger action *now*.
segments.tr: 판매촉진** — 즉시 행동을 유발하기 위한 단기 인센티브.

segments.src: Coupons, BOGO, rebates, limited-time bundles, loyalty points, free samples.
segments.tr: 쿠폰, BOGO, 환급, 기한부 번들, 로열티 포인트, 무료 샘플.

segments.src: Strength: fast, measurable, great for driving trial.
segments.tr: 강점: 빠르고 측정 가능하며 시험 구매 유도에 탁월합니다.

segments.src: Weakness: it's borrowed demand.
segments.tr: 약점: 빌린 수요입니다.

segments.src: Run it too often and you train customers to never pay full price.
segments.tr: 너무 자주 실행하면 고객들이 정가를 지불하지 않도록 학습시킵니다.

segments.src: Personal selling** — a human being in a two-way conversation.
segments.tr: 개인판매** — 쌍방향 대화에서의 인간관계.

segments.src: The salesperson on the floor, the enterprise rep on a call.
segments.tr: 매장 바닥의 판매원, 통화의 엔터프라이즈 담당자.

segments.src: Strength: it adapts in real time, handles objections, and closes complicated deals.
segments.tr: 강점: 실시간으로 적응하고 이의를 처리하며 복잡한 거래를 성사시킵니다.

segments.src: Weakness: it's by far the most expensive per contact.
segments.tr: 약점: 연락당 단연코 가장 비용이 많이 드는 방법입니다.

segments.src: Most modern textbooks add a fifth: **direct and digital marketing** — email, SMS, targeted social, direct mail — messages aimed at specific known individuals with a response mechanism built in.
segments.tr: 대부분의 현대 교재는 다섯 번째를 추가합니다: **직접 및 디지털 마케팅** — 이메일, SMS, 타겟된 소셜, 직접 우편 — 반응 메커니즘이 내장된 특정 개인을 대상으로 하는 메시지.

segments.src: Two ideas tie the toolkit together.
segments.tr: 두 가지 개념이 이 도구들을 함께 묶습니다.

segments.src: **Push vs.
segments.tr: **Push vs.

segments.src: pull.** A *push* strategy aims promotion at the channel: trade discounts and sales reps that get retailers to stock and push your product.
segments.tr: pull.** *push* 전략은 판촉을 유통 채널에 목표로 합니다: 소매점이 제품을 진열하고 판매하도록 유도하는 거래 할인과 영업 담당자.

segments.src: A *pull* strategy aims at the end customer, so they walk in and ask for it by name, and retailers stock it because demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: *pull* 전략은 최종 고객을 목표로 하므로 그들이 방문하여 이름으로 요청하고, 소매점은 수요가 이를 견인하기 때문에 진열합니다.

segments.src: Most companies run both.
segments.tr: 대부분의 회사는 둘 다 실행합니다.

segments.src: **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC).** Different tools, different budgets, different agencies — but the customer doesn't see departments.
segments.tr: **통합마케팅커뮤니케이션(IMC).** 다른 도구, 다른 예산, 다른 대행사 — 하지만 고객은 부서를 보지 않습니다.

segments.src: They see one brand.
segments.tr: 그들은 하나의 브랜드를 봅니다.

segments.src: If your ad says "premium craftsmanship" while your email says "70% OFF — TODAY ONLY," you've spent two budgets to confuse one person.
segments.tr: 광고가 "프리미엄 장인정신"이라고 하는데 이메일이 "70% 할인 — 오늘만"이라고 하면, 두 개의 예산을 들여 한 사람을 혼란스럽게 만든 것입니다.

segments.src: IMC just means coordinating every message so they compound instead of cancel.
segments.tr: IMC는 단지 모든 메시지를 조정하여 상쇄되지 않고 복합적으로 작용하도록 하는 것입니다.

segments.src: The mix shifts with what you sell.
segments.tr: 혼합은 판매하는 제품에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: Consumer packaged goods — soda, snacks, shampoo — lean heavily on advertising and sales promotion.
segments.tr: 소비자 상품 — 탄산음료, 스낵, 샴푸 — 광고와 판매촉진에 크게 의존합니다.

segments.src: Industrial and B2B products — a $400,000 piece of factory equipment — lean on personal selling, because someone has to answer twenty specific questions before a purchase order gets signed.
segments.tr: 산업용 및 B2B 제품 — 40만 달러의 공장 장비 — 개인판매에 의존합니다. 누군가 구매 주문서에 서명하기 전에 20개의 특정 질문에 답해야 하기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상 속에서

segments.src: Say it's Saturday in Columbus, Ohio, and you need a new mattress.
segments.tr: 오하이오주 콜럼버스의 토요일이고 새 침대가 필요하다고 가정합시다.

segments.src: Over coffee you skip a YouTube ad for Restwell Mattress — but you catch the tagline.
segments.tr: 커피를 마시면서 Restwell Mattress의 YouTube 광고를 건너뛰지만, 슬로건을 봅니다.

segments.src: **That's advertising.** Paid, controlled, aimed at everyone.
segments.tr: **그것이 광고입니다.** 유료, 제어됨, 모두를 대상으로.

segments.src: Scrolling the local news, you see a piece: "Columbus mattress company donates 500 beds to area shelters."
segments.tr: 지역 뉴스를 스크롤하면 다음과 같은 기사를 봅니다: "콜럼버스 침대 회사가 지역 쉼터에 500개의 침대를 기부합니다."

segments.src: Nobody paid the *Dispatch* to run that story; the company's PR team pitched it and a reporter thought it was worth covering.
segments.tr: 아무도 *Dispatch*에게 그 기사를 실으라고 돈을 지불하지 않았습니다. 회사의 PR팀이 이를 제안했고 기자가 이를 다룰 가치가 있다고 생각했습니다.

segments.src: You trust it more than the ad, precisely because it isn't an ad.
segments.tr: 광고가 아니라는 정확한 이유로 광고보다 더 신뢰합니다.

segments.src: **That's PR.**
segments.tr: **그것이 PR입니다.**

segments.src: In your inbox: "Presidents' Day Sale — $300 off any queen set, ends Monday."
segments.tr: 받은편지함: "대통령의 날 세일 — 모든 퀸 침대에서 300달러 할인, 월요일 종료."

segments.src: Nothing about the mattress changed.
segments.tr: 침대 자체는 변하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: What changed is that waiting until April now costs you $300.
segments.tr: 변한 것은 4월까지 기다리는 것이 이제 300달러의 비용이 든다는 것입니다.

segments.src: **That's sales promotion** — and note the deadline, which is the whole point.
segments.tr: **그것이 판매촉진입니다** — 그리고 마감일을 주목하세요. 이것이 핵심입니다.

segments.src: You drive over.
segments.tr: 당신은 운전해서 갑니다.

segments.src: An employee asks how you sleep, hears "my lower back's been rough," and walks you to three medium-firm models between $899 and $1,400 — then throws in free delivery to close it.
segments.tr: 직원이 당신이 어떻게 자는지 묻고 "허리가 안 좋아요"라고 듣고는 899달러~1400달러 사이의 중간 정도 견고한 세 가지 모델로 안내한 후 거래를 성사시키기 위해 무료 배송을 던집니다.

segments.src: That personalized twenty minutes cost the company far more than the ad impression did, but it's what actually converted the sale.
segments.tr: 그 맞춤형 20분은 회사에 광고 노출보다 훨씬 더 많은 비용이 들었지만, 실제로 판매를 전환한 것입니다.

segments.src: **That's personal selling.**
segments.tr: **그것이 개인판매입니다.**

segments.src: Four tools, one purchase.
segments.tr: 네 가지 도구, 한 번의 구매.

segments.src: And notice: if the ad had promised luxury while the email screamed clearance and the salesperson pushed the cheapest floor model, you'd have walked out unsure what this brand even is.
segments.tr: 그리고 주목하세요: 광고가 럭셔리를 약속했지만 이메일이 재고 일괄 처분을 외쳤고 판매원이 가장 저렴한 바닥 모델을 밀었다면, 이 브랜드가 무엇인지 확실하지 않은 상태로 나갔을 것입니다.

segments.src: That's the IMC problem in one afternoon.
segments.tr: 그것이 한 오후의 IMC 문제입니다.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 세 줄 요약

segments.src: 1. The promotion mix has four classic tools — advertising, PR, sales promotion, and personal selling — plus direct/digital marketing, and each does a different job.
segments.tr: 1. 판촉 혼합에는 네 가지 전통적인 도구 — 광고, PR, 판매촉진, 개인판매 — 와 직접/디지털 마케팅이 있으며, 각각 다른 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: 2. Advertising buys reach, PR earns credibility, sales promotion creates urgency, and personal selling closes complexity — which is why the right mix depends on what you sell and to whom.
segments.tr: 2. 광고는 도달 범위를 구입하고, PR은 신뢰도를 얻고, 판매촉진은 긴박성을 만들고, 개인판매는 복잡성을 해결합니다. 올바른 혼합이 무엇을 판매하는지와 누구에게 판매하는지에 따라 달라지는 이유입니다.

segments.src: 3. Whatever mix you choose, integrate it: one inconsistent message can undo the budgets behind all the others.
segments.tr: 3. 선택한 혼합이 무엇이든 통합하세요: 하나의 불일치한 메시지는 다른 모든 메시지 뒤의 예산을 무효화할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 자체 점검 퀴즈

segments.src: **Q1.** A software company sells a $250,000 annual enterprise contract that requires custom setup and sign-off from four executives.
segments.tr: **Q1.** 소프트웨어 회사가 250,000달러 연간 엔터프라이즈 계약을 판매하는데, 이는 맞춤형 설정과 4명의 임원 승인이 필요합니다.

segments.src: Which promotion tool should carry the most weight?
segments.tr: 어떤 판촉 도구가 가장 많은 비중을 차지해야 합니까?

segments.src: - A) Television advertising
segments.tr: - A) 텔레비전 광고

segments.src: - B) Personal selling
segments.tr: - B) 개인판매

segments.src: - C) Coupons
segments.tr: - C) 쿠폰

segments.src: - D) Free samples
segments.tr: - D) 무료 샘플

segments.src: **Q2.** True or False — Public relations is essentially free, since you don't pay for the media placement.
segments.tr: **Q2.** 참 또는 거짓 — 미디어 게재에 비용을 지불하지 않기 때문에 공중관계는 본질적으로 무료입니다.

segments.src: **Q3.** A snack brand offers a deep discount every single month.
segments.tr: **Q3.** 스낵 브랜드가 매달 큰 할인을 제공합니다.

segments.src: What's the most likely long-term risk?
segments.tr: 가장 가능성 높은 장기적 위험은 무엇입니까?

segments.src: - A) Customers learn to wait for the discount and stop paying full price
segments.tr: - A) 고객이 할인을 기다리는 법을 배우고 정가를 지불하지 않습니다

segments.src: - B) The product's manufacturing cost rises
segments.tr: - B) 제품의 제조 비용이 증가합니다

segments.src: - C) Retailers are legally barred from stocking it
segments.tr: - C) 소매점은 법적으로 이를 진열하지 못하도록 금지됩니다

segments.src: - D) Advertising becomes impossible
segments.tr: - D) 광고가 불가능해집니다

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Promotion mix** — the combination of communication tools a company uses to reach and persuade its target market.
segments.tr: - **판촉 혼합** — 회사가 목표 시장에 도달하고 설득하기 위해 사용하는 커뮤니케이션 도구의 조합.

segments.src: - **Advertising** — any paid, non-personal form of presentation or promotion by an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: - **광고** — 특정 스폰서가 제시하는 유료, 비인격적 형태의 프리젠테이션 또는 판촉.

segments.src: - **Sales promotion** — a short-term incentive designed to encourage immediate trial or purchase.
segments.tr: - **판매촉진** — 즉각적인 시험 또는 구매를 장려하도록 설계된 단기 인센티브.

segments.src: - **Push vs. pull strategy** — promoting *to the channel* so it stocks and pushes your product, versus promoting *to end customers* so their demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: - **Push vs. pull 전략** — 유통 채널을 *대상으로* 판촉하여 제품을 진열하고 판매하게 하는 것 대 최종 고객을 *대상으로* 판촉하여 수요가 이를 견인하도록 하는 것.

segments.src: - **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC)** — coordinating all promotional channels so the brand delivers one clear, consistent message.
segments.tr: - **통합마케팅커뮤니케이션(IMC)** — 브랜드가 하나의 명확하고 일관된 메시지를 전달하도록 모든 판촉 채널을 조정합니다.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** High-value, complex, multi-stakeholder purchases need two-way conversation, objection handling, and customization.
segments.tr: *답변: **Q1 — B.** 고가, 복잡, 다중 이해관계자 구매는 쌍방향 대화, 이의 처리, 맞춤형이 필요합니다.

segments.src: The cost per contact is high, but the deal size easily justifies it.
segments.tr: 연락당 비용은 높지만 거래 규모가 이를 충분히 정당화합니다.

segments.src: **Q2 — False.** You don't pay for the placement, but you do pay for PR staff, agencies, events, and time — and unlike advertising, you can't control what actually gets said.
segments.tr: **Q2 — 거짓.** 게재에는 비용을 지불하지 않지만 PR 직원, 대행사, 이벤트, 시간에는 비용을 지불합니다. 광고와 달리 실제로 말해지는 것을 제어할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: **Q3 — A.** Constant discounting reframes the sale price as the real price.
segments.tr: **Q3 — A.** 지속적인 할인은 판매 가격을 실제 가격으로 재정의합니다.

segments.src: Customers simply wait, and the brand's perceived value and margins both erode.*
segments.tr: 고객은 단순히 기다리고, 브랜드의 인식된 가치와 이윤이 모두 약해집니다.*

zh.title: [Marketing 101 #10] 广告、优惠券和销售员都应该讲述同一个故事

segments.src: > Promotion isn't just advertising — it's four different tools (advertising, PR, sales promotion, personal selling) that work best when they say one consistent thing.
segments.tr: > 推广不仅仅是广告——它是四种不同的工具（广告、公关、销售促进、人员销售），当它们传达一致的信息时效果最好。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今天的概念

segments.src: Promotion is the "P" that handles communication.
segments.tr: 推广是处理沟通的"P"。

segments.src: You've built a product, priced it, and put it somewhere people can buy it.
segments.tr: 你已经开发了产品、定价，并将其放在人们可以购买的地方。

segments.src: None of that matters if nobody knows about it, believes it, or has a reason to act this month instead of someday.
segments.tr: 如果没有人知道它、相信它，或者没有理由在这个月而不是将来采取行动，那么这一切都无关紧要。

segments.src: Marketers usually break promotion into four classic tools, each with a different job:
segments.tr: 营销人员通常将推广分为四种经典工具，每种都有不同的职能：

segments.src: Advertising** — paid, non-personal messaging from an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: 广告**——来自确定赞助商的付费、非个人信息。

segments.src: A streaming-service ad break, a billboard on I-95, a sponsored search result.
segments.tr: 流媒体服务的广告中断、I-95上的广告牌、赞助搜索结果。

segments.src: Strength: it reaches enormous numbers of people cheaply *per person*, and you control the message word for word.
segments.tr: 优势：以很低的*人均*成本接触到大量人群，你可以逐字控制信息内容。

segments.src: Weakness: it's one-way, easy to ignore, and audiences discount it because they know you paid for it.
segments.tr: 劣势：这是单向的、容易被忽视，观众会打折扣，因为他们知道你为此付费了。

segments.src: Public relations (PR)** — earning favorable attention rather than buying placement.
segments.tr: 公共关系（PR）**——赚取好评而不是购买版面。

segments.src: Press outreach, founder interviews, community sponsorships, crisis response.
segments.tr: 新闻宣传、创始人采访、社区赞助、危机回应。

segments.src: Strength: high credibility, because a reporter or a neighbor said it, not your ad copy.
segments.tr: 优势：高可信度，因为是记者或邻居说的，而不是你的广告文案。

segments.src: Weakness: you don't control it.
segments.tr: 劣势：你无法控制它。

segments.src: PR isn't free — you pay staff and agencies — you just can't guarantee the outcome.
segments.tr: 公关不是免费的——你要支付员工和代理费用——你只是无法保证结果。

segments.src: Sales promotion** — short-term incentives to trigger action *now*.
segments.tr: 销售促进**——短期激励以引发*现在*的行动。

segments.src: Coupons, BOGO, rebates, limited-time bundles, loyalty points, free samples.
segments.tr: 优惠券、买一送一、回扣、限时捆绑、忠诚度积分、免费样品。

segments.src: Strength: fast, measurable, great for driving trial.
segments.tr: 优势：快速、可衡量、非常适合推动试用。

segments.src: Weakness: it's borrowed demand.
segments.tr: 劣势：这是借来的需求。

segments.src: Run it too often and you train customers to never pay full price.
segments.tr: 运行过于频繁，你就会让客户永远不愿意全价购买。

segments.src: Personal selling** — a human being in a two-way conversation.
segments.tr: 人员销售**——两个人之间的双向对话。

segments.src: The salesperson on the floor, the enterprise rep on a call.
segments.tr: 楼层上的销售人员、电话中的企业代表。

segments.src: Strength: it adapts in real time, handles objections, and closes complicated deals.
segments.tr: 优势：它能够实时适应，处理异议，促成复杂交易。

segments.src: Weakness: it's by far the most expensive per contact.
segments.tr: 劣势：这是迄今为止每次接触最昂贵的。

segments.src: Most modern textbooks add a fifth: **direct and digital marketing** — email, SMS, targeted social, direct mail — messages aimed at specific known individuals with a response mechanism built in.
segments.tr: 大多数现代教科书加入第五种：**直接和数字营销**——电子邮件、短信、有针对性的社交、直邮——针对特定已知个人的信息，内置回复机制。

segments.src: Two ideas tie the toolkit together.
segments.tr: 两个概念将工具包联系在一起。

segments.src: **Push vs.
segments.tr: **推式与

segments.src: pull.** A *push* strategy aims promotion at the channel: trade discounts and sales reps that get retailers to stock and push your product.
segments.tr: 拉式。** *推式*策略针对渠道推广：通过贸易折扣和销售代表来鼓励零售商库存并推销你的产品。

segments.src: A *pull* strategy aims at the end customer, so they walk in and ask for it by name, and retailers stock it because demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: *拉式*策略针对最终客户，使他们走进店铺并按名字要求该产品，零售商库存它是因为客户需求拉动了销售。

segments.src: Most companies run both.
segments.tr: 大多数公司同时运行两种。

segments.src: **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC).** Different tools, different budgets, different agencies — but the customer doesn't see departments.
segments.tr: **整合营销传播（IMC）。** 不同的工具、不同的预算、不同的代理——但客户看不到部门。

segments.src: They see one brand.
segments.tr: 他们看到一个品牌。

segments.src: If your ad says "premium craftsmanship" while your email says "70% OFF — TODAY ONLY," you've spent two budgets to confuse one person.
segments.tr: 如果你的广告说"优质工艺"而你的电子邮件说"70% OFF — 仅今天," 你已经花费两个预算来迷惑一个人。

segments.src: IMC just means coordinating every message so they compound instead of cancel.
segments.tr: IMC只是意味着协调每条信息，使其相互加强而不是相互抵消。

segments.src: The mix shifts with what you sell.
segments.tr: 推广组合随你销售的产品而变化。

segments.src: Consumer packaged goods — soda, snacks, shampoo — lean heavily on advertising and sales promotion.
segments.tr: 消费者包装商品——苏打水、零食、洗发水——大量依靠广告和销售促进。

segments.src: Industrial and B2B products — a $400,000 piece of factory equipment — lean on personal selling, because someone has to answer twenty specific questions before a purchase order gets signed.
segments.tr: 工业和B2B产品——比如价值$400,000的工厂设备——依靠人员销售，因为采购订单签署前有人必须回答二十个具体问题。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 在日常生活中

segments.src: Say it's Saturday in Columbus, Ohio, and you need a new mattress.
segments.tr: 假设现在是俄亥俄州哥伦布市的星期六，你需要一个新床垫。

segments.src: Over coffee you skip a YouTube ad for Restwell Mattress — but you catch the tagline.
segments.tr: 喝咖啡时你跳过Restwell床垫的YouTube广告——但你抓住了标语。

segments.src: **That's advertising.** Paid, controlled, aimed at everyone.
segments.tr: **这是广告。** 付费的、受控的、针对所有人的。

segments.src: Scrolling the local news, you see a piece: "Columbus mattress company donates 500 beds to area shelters."
segments.tr: 滚动本地新闻时，你看到一篇文章："哥伦布床垫公司向地区收容所捐赠500张床。"

segments.src: Nobody paid the *Dispatch* to run that story; the company's PR team pitched it and a reporter thought it was worth covering.
segments.tr: 没有人支付*Dispatch*来刊登那个故事；公司的公关团队推销了它，记者认为值得报道。

segments.src: You trust it more than the ad, precisely because it isn't an ad.
segments.tr: 你比广告更信任它，正因为它不是广告。

segments.src: **That's PR.**
segments.tr: **这是公关。**

segments.src: In your inbox: "Presidents' Day Sale — $300 off any queen set, ends Monday."
segments.tr: 在你的收件箱中："Presidents' Day Sale——任何queen套装减$300，周一结束。"

segments.src: Nothing about the mattress changed.
segments.tr: 床垫没有任何改变。

segments.src: What changed is that waiting until April now costs you $300.
segments.tr: 改变的是等到四月现在要花费$300。

segments.src: **That's sales promotion** — and note the deadline, which is the whole point.
segments.tr: **这是销售促进**——注意最后期限，这是关键。

segments.src: You drive over.
segments.tr: 你开过去。

segments.src: An employee asks how you sleep, hears "my lower back's been rough," and walks you to three medium-firm models between $899 and $1,400 — then throws in free delivery to close it.
segments.tr: 一名员工问你的睡眠情况，听到"我的下背部一直很不舒服"，为你介绍了$899到$1,400之间的三个中等硬度的型号——然后加入免费送货来完成这笔交易。

segments.src: That personalized twenty minutes cost the company far more than the ad impression did, but it's what actually converted the sale.
segments.tr: 那个个性化的二十分钟比广告印象的成本要高得多，但这正是实际促成销售的原因。

segments.src: **That's personal selling.**
segments.tr: **这是人员销售。**

segments.src: Four tools, one purchase.
segments.tr: 四个工具，一次购买。

segments.src: And notice: if the ad had promised luxury while the email screamed clearance and the salesperson pushed the cheapest floor model, you'd have walked out unsure what this brand even is.
segments.tr: 注意：如果广告承诺奢侈品，电子邮件大喊清仓，销售员推销最便宜的楼层展示型号，你会对这个品牌的身份感到困惑。

segments.src: That's the IMC problem in one afternoon.
segments.tr: 这是一个下午的IMC问题。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 三行回顾

segments.src: 1. The promotion mix has four classic tools — advertising, PR, sales promotion, and personal selling — plus direct/digital marketing, and each does a different job.
segments.tr: 1. 推广混合有四种经典工具——广告、公关、销售促进和人员销售——加上直接/数字营销，每种都有不同的职能。

segments.src: 2. Advertising buys reach, PR earns credibility, sales promotion creates urgency, and personal selling closes complexity — which is why the right mix depends on what you sell and to whom.
segments.tr: 2. 广告购买覆盖面，公关赚取可信度，销售促进创造紧迫感，人员销售解决复杂性——这就是为什么正确的混合取决于你销售什么以及销售给谁。

segments.src: 3. Whatever mix you choose, integrate it: one inconsistent message can undo the budgets behind all the others.
segments.tr: 3. 无论你选择什么样的混合，整合它：一条不一致的信息可以撤销所有其他消息背后的预算。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 自我测验

segments.src: **Q1.** A software company sells a $250,000 annual enterprise contract that requires custom setup and sign-off from four executives.
segments.tr: **Q1.** 一家软件公司销售价值$250,000的年度企业合同，需要来自四名高管的自定义设置和批准。

segments.src: Which promotion tool should carry the most weight?
segments.tr: 哪种推广工具应该承载最多的权重？

segments.src: - A) Television advertising
segments.tr: - A) 电视广告

segments.src: - B) Personal selling
segments.tr: - B) 人员销售

segments.src: - C) Coupons
segments.tr: - C) 优惠券

segments.src: - D) Free samples
segments.tr: - D) 免费样品

segments.src: **Q2.** True or False — Public relations is essentially free, since you don't pay for the media placement.
segments.tr: **Q2.** 真或假——公共关系本质上是免费的，因为你不需要为媒体版面付费。

segments.src: **Q3.** A snack brand offers a deep discount every single month.
segments.tr: **Q3.** 一个零食品牌每个月都提供深度折扣。

segments.src: What's the most likely long-term risk?
segments.tr: 最可能的长期风险是什么？

segments.src: - A) Customers learn to wait for the discount and stop paying full price
segments.tr: - A) 客户学会等待折扣并停止支付全价

segments.src: - B) The product's manufacturing cost rises
segments.tr: - B) 产品的制造成本上升

segments.src: - C) Retailers are legally barred from stocking it
segments.tr: - C) 零售商被法律禁止库存它

segments.src: - D) Advertising becomes impossible
segments.tr: - D) 广告变得不可能

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今天的术语

segments.src: - **Promotion mix** — the combination of communication tools a company uses to reach and persuade its target market.
segments.tr: - **推广混合**——公司用来接触和说服目标市场的沟通工具的组合。

segments.src: - **Advertising** — any paid, non-personal form of presentation or promotion by an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: - **广告**——任何由确定赞助商进行的付费、非个人形式的呈现或推广。

segments.src: - **Sales promotion** — a short-term incentive designed to encourage immediate trial or purchase.
segments.tr: - **销售促进**——旨在鼓励立即试用或购买的短期激励措施。

segments.src: - **Push vs. pull strategy** — promoting *to the channel* so it stocks and pushes your product, versus promoting *to end customers* so their demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: - **推式与拉式策略**——向*渠道*推广，使其库存并推动你的产品，相对于向*最终客户*推广，使他们的需求拉动产品销售。

segments.src: - **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC)** — coordinating all promotional channels so the brand delivers one clear, consistent message.
segments.tr: - **整合营销传播（IMC）**——协调所有推广渠道，使品牌传递一个明确、一致的信息。

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** High-value, complex, multi-stakeholder purchases need two-way conversation, objection handling, and customization.
segments.tr: *答案：**Q1——B。** 高价值、复杂、多利益相关者的购买需要双向对话、异议处理和定制。

segments.src: The cost per contact is high, but the deal size easily justifies it.
segments.tr: 每次接触的成本很高，但交易规模很容易证明这是合理的。

segments.src: **Q2 — False.** You don't pay for the placement, but you do pay for PR staff, agencies, events, and time — and unlike advertising, you can't control what actually gets said.
segments.tr: **Q2——假。** 你不需要为版面付费，但你需要为公关员工、代理、事件和时间付费——与广告不同，你无法控制实际说的内容。

segments.src: **Q3 — A.** Constant discounting reframes the sale price as the real price.
segments.tr: **Q3——A。** 持续折扣将销售价格重新定义为真实价格。

segments.src: Customers simply wait, and the brand's perceived value and margins both erode.*
segments.tr: 客户只是等待，品牌的感知价值和利润都会下降。*

hi.title: [Marketing 101 #10] विज्ञापन, कूपन और विक्रय प्रतिनिधि सभी को एक ही कहानी कहनी चाहिए

segments.src: > Promotion isn't just advertising — it's four different tools (advertising, PR, sales promotion, personal selling) that work best when they say one consistent thing.
segments.tr: > प्रचार केवल विज्ञापन नहीं है — यह चार अलग-अलग उपकरण (विज्ञापन, जनसंपर्क, बिक्री प्रचार, व्यक्तिगत विक्रय) हैं जो सर्वोत्तम तब काम करते हैं जब वे एक सुसंगत बात कहते हैं।

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## आज की अवधारणा

segments.src: Promotion is the "P" that handles communication.
segments.tr: प्रचार वह "P" है जो संचार को संभालता है।

segments.src: You've built a product, priced it, and put it somewhere people can buy it.
segments.tr: आपने एक उत्पाद बनाया है, इसकी कीमत निर्धारित की है, और इसे ऐसी जगह रखा है जहां लोग इसे खरीद सकते हैं।

segments.src: None of that matters if nobody knows about it, believes it, or has a reason to act this month instead of someday.
segments.tr: अगर कोई इसके बारे में नहीं जानता है, इस पर विश्वास नहीं करता है, या किसी दिन की बजाय इस महीने कार्य करने का कोई कारण नहीं है तो इनमें से कोई भी मायने नहीं रखता।

segments.src: Marketers usually break promotion into four classic tools, each with a different job:
segments.tr: विपणक आमतौर पर प्रचार को चार क्लासिक उपकरणों में विभाजित करते हैं, प्रत्येक का एक अलग काम है:

segments.src: Advertising** — paid, non-personal messaging from an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: विज्ञापन** — एक पहचाने गए प्रायोजक से भुगतान किया गया, गैर-व्यक्तिगत संदेश।

segments.src: A streaming-service ad break, a billboard on I-95, a sponsored search result.
segments.tr: एक स्ट्रीमिंग-सेवा विज्ञापन विराम, I-95 पर एक बिलबोर्ड, एक प्रायोजित खोज परिणाम।

segments.src: Strength: it reaches enormous numbers of people cheaply *per person*, and you control the message word for word.
segments.tr: शक्ति: यह बहुत बड़ी संख्या में लोगों तक *प्रति व्यक्ति* सस्ते में पहुंचता है, और आप संदेश को शब्द दर शब्द नियंत्रित करते हैं।

segments.src: Weakness: it's one-way, easy to ignore, and audiences discount it because they know you paid for it.
segments.tr: कमजोरी: यह एकतरफा है, इसे अनदेखा करना आसान है, और दर्शक इसे छूट देते हैं क्योंकि वे जानते हैं कि आपने इसके लिए भुगतान किया है।

segments.src: Public relations (PR)** — earning favorable attention rather than buying placement.
segments.tr: जनसंपर्क (PR)** — प्लेसमेंट खरीदने के बजाय अनुकूल ध्यान अर्जित करना।

segments.src: Press outreach, founder interviews, community sponsorships, crisis response.
segments.tr: प्रेस पहुंच, संस्थापक साक्षात्कार, सामुदायिक प्रायोजन, संकट प्रतिक्रिया।

segments.src: Strength: high credibility, because a reporter or a neighbor said it, not your ad copy.
segments.tr: शक्ति: उच्च विश्वसनीयता, क्योंकि एक पत्रकार या एक पड़ोसी ने इसे कहा, आपकी विज्ञापन प्रति नहीं।

segments.src: Weakness: you don't control it.
segments.tr: कमजोरी: आप इसे नियंत्रित नहीं करते हैं।

segments.src: PR isn't free — you pay staff and agencies — you just can't guarantee the outcome.
segments.tr: PR मुफ्त नहीं है — आप कर्मचारियों और एजेंसियों को भुगतान करते हैं — आप केवल परिणाम की गारंटी नहीं दे सकते।

segments.src: Sales promotion** — short-term incentives to trigger action *now*.
segments.tr: बिक्री प्रचार** — *अभी* कार्रवाई को ट्रिगर करने के लिए अल्पकालिक प्रोत्साहन।

segments.src: Coupons, BOGO, rebates, limited-time bundles, loyalty points, free samples.
segments.tr: कूपन, BOGO, रिबेट, सीमित-समय बंडल, आनुगत्य अंक, मुफ्त नमूने।

segments.src: Strength: fast, measurable, great for driving trial.
segments.tr: शक्ति: तेज़, मापने योग्य, परीक्षण चलाने के लिए बहुत अच्छा।

segments.src: Weakness: it's borrowed demand.
segments.tr: कमजोरी: यह उधार ली गई मांग है।

segments.src: Run it too often and you train customers to never pay full price.
segments.tr: इसे बहुत बार चलाएं और आप ग्राहकों को कभी भी पूरी कीमत का भुगतान न करने के लिए प्रशिक्षित करते हैं।

segments.src: Personal selling** — a human being in a two-way conversation.
segments.tr: व्यक्तिगत विक्रय** — एक मानव दो-तरफा बातचीत में।

segments.src: The salesperson on the floor, the enterprise rep on a call.
segments.tr: फर्श पर विक्रय प्रतिनिधि, कॉल पर उद्यम प्रतिनिधि।

segments.src: Strength: it adapts in real time, handles objections, and closes complicated deals.
segments.tr: शक्ति: यह रीयल टाइम में अनुकूल होता है, आपत्तियों को संभालता है, और जटिल सौदों को बंद करता है।

segments.src: Weakness: it's by far the most expensive per contact.
segments.tr: कमजोरी: यह प्रति संपर्क सबसे महंगा है।

segments.src: Most modern textbooks add a fifth: **direct and digital marketing** — email, SMS, targeted social, direct mail — messages aimed at specific known individuals with a response mechanism built in.
segments.tr: अधिकांश आधुनिक पाठ्यपुस्तकें एक पांचवां जोड़ते हैं: **प्रत्यक्ष और डिजिटल विपणन** — ईमेल, SMS, लक्षित सामाजिक, प्रत्यक्ष मेल — विशिष्ट ज्ञात व्यक्तियों को संदेश जिसमें एक प्रतिक्रिया तंत्र बनाया हुआ है।

segments.src: Two ideas tie the toolkit together.
segments.tr: दो विचार उपकरण किट को एक साथ बांधते हैं।

segments.src: **Push vs.
segments.tr: **पुश बनाम।

segments.src: pull.** A *push* strategy aims promotion at the channel: trade discounts and sales reps that get retailers to stock and push your product.
segments.tr: खींच।** एक *पुश* रणनीति चैनल पर प्रचार का लक्ष्य रखती है: व्यापार छूट और विक्रय प्रतिनिधि जो खुदरा विक्रेताओं को आपके उत्पाद को स्टॉक और पुश करने के लिए प्राप्त करते हैं।

segments.src: A *pull* strategy aims at the end customer, so they walk in and ask for it by name, and retailers stock it because demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: एक *खींच* रणनीति अंतिम ग्राहक को लक्ष्य करती है, इसलिए वे अंदर आते हैं और इसे नाम से मांगते हैं, और खुदरा विक्रेता इसे स्टॉक करते हैं क्योंकि मांग इसे खींच लेती है।

segments.src: Most companies run both.
segments.tr: अधिकांश कंपनियां दोनों को चलाती हैं।

segments.src: **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC).** Different tools, different budgets, different agencies — but the customer doesn't see departments.
segments.tr: **एकीकृत विपणन संचार (IMC)।** विभिन्न उपकरण, विभिन्न बजट, विभिन्न एजेंसियां — लेकिन ग्राहक विभागों को नहीं देखता है।

segments.src: They see one brand.
segments.tr: वे एक ब्रांड देखते हैं।

segments.src: If your ad says "premium craftsmanship" while your email says "70% OFF — TODAY ONLY," you've spent two budgets to confuse one person.
segments.tr: यदि आपका विज्ञापन "प्रीमियम कारीगरी" कहता है जबकि आपकी ईमेल "70% OFF — केवल आज" कहती है, तो आपने एक व्यक्ति को भ्रमित करने के लिए दो बजट खर्च किए हैं।

segments.src: IMC just means coordinating every message so they compound instead of cancel.
segments.tr: IMC का अर्थ है प्रत्येक संदेश को समन्वित करना ताकि वे रद्द करने के बजाय चक्रवृद्धि हों।

segments.src: The mix shifts with what you sell.
segments.tr: मिश्रण आपके द्वारा बेचे जाने वाले के साथ बदलता है।

segments.src: Consumer packaged goods — soda, snacks, shampoo — lean heavily on advertising and sales promotion.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता पैकेज्ड सामान — सोडा, स्नैक्स, शैम्पू — विज्ञापन और बिक्री प्रचार पर बहुत निर्भर करते हैं।

segments.src: Industrial and B2B products — a $400,000 piece of factory equipment — lean on personal selling, because someone has to answer twenty specific questions before a purchase order gets signed.
segments.tr: औद्योगिक और B2B उत्पाद — $400,000 कारखाने के उपकरण का एक टुकड़ा — व्यक्तिगत विक्रय पर निर्भर करते हैं, क्योंकि किसी को खरीद आदेश पर हस्ताक्षर करने से पहले बीस विशिष्ट प्रश्नों का उत्तर देना होता है।

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## रोज़मर्रा की जिंदगी में

segments.src: Say it's Saturday in Columbus, Ohio, and you need a new mattress.
segments.tr: मान लीजिए कि यह कोलंबस, ओहियो में शनिवार है, और आपको एक नए गद्दे की जरूरत है।

segments.src: Over coffee you skip a YouTube ad for Restwell Mattress — but you catch the tagline.
segments.tr: कॉफी के दौरान आप Restwell गद्दे के लिए एक YouTube विज्ञापन को छोड़ते हैं — लेकिन आप टैगलाइन को पकड़ते हैं।

segments.src: **That's advertising.** Paid, controlled, aimed at everyone.
segments.tr: **वह विज्ञापन है।** भुगतान किया गया, नियंत्रित, सभी को लक्ष्य किया गया।

segments.src: Scrolling the local news, you see a piece: "Columbus mattress company donates 500 beds to area shelters."
segments.tr: स्थानीय समाचार को स्क्रॉल करते हुए, आप एक टुकड़ा देखते हैं: "कोलंबस गद्दे की कंपनी क्षेत्र के आश्रयों को 500 बिस्तर दान करती है।"

segments.src: Nobody paid the *Dispatch* to run that story; the company's PR team pitched it and a reporter thought it was worth covering.
segments.tr: किसी ने *Dispatch* को उस कहानी को चलाने के लिए भुगतान नहीं किया; कंपनी की PR टीम ने इसे पिच किया और एक पत्रकार को लगा कि यह कवर करने के लायक है।

segments.src: You trust it more than the ad, precisely because it isn't an ad.
segments.tr: आप इसे विज्ञापन से अधिक विश्वास करते हैं, बिल्कुल क्योंकि यह एक विज्ञापन नहीं है।

segments.src: **That's PR.**
segments.tr: **वह PR है।**

segments.src: In your inbox: "Presidents' Day Sale — $300 off any queen set, ends Monday."
segments.tr: आपके इनबॉक्स में: "राष्ट्रपति दिवस की बिक्री — किसी भी रानी सेट पर $300 की छूट, सोमवार को समाप्त।"

segments.src: Nothing about the mattress changed.
segments.tr: गद्दे के बारे में कुछ नहीं बदला।

segments.src: What changed is that waiting until April now costs you $300.
segments.tr: जो बदला वह है कि अप्रैल तक प्रतीक्षा करने के लिए अब आपको $300 खर्च होंगे।

segments.src: **That's sales promotion** — and note the deadline, which is the whole point.
segments.tr: **वह बिक्री प्रचार है** — और समय सीमा पर ध्यान दें, जो पूरी बात है।

segments.src: You drive over.
segments.tr: आप ड्राइव करते हैं।

segments.src: An employee asks how you sleep, hears "my lower back's been rough," and walks you to three medium-firm models between $899 and $1,400 — then throws in free delivery to close it.
segments.tr: एक कर्मचारी पूछता है कि आप कैसे सोते हैं, "मेरी पीठ के निचले हिस्से में खुरदरापन है," सुनता है, और आपको $899 और $1,400 के बीच तीन मध्यम-दृढ़ मॉडलों तक ले जाता है — फिर इसे बंद करने के लिए मुफ्त डिलीवरी में फेंक देता है।

segments.src: That personalized twenty minutes cost the company far more than the ad impression did, but it's what actually converted the sale.
segments.tr: उस व्यक्तिगत बीस मिनट की लागत कंपनी को विज्ञापन इंप्रेशन की तुलना में बहुत अधिक थी, लेकिन यह वही है जिसने वास्तव में बिक्री को परिवर्तित किया।

segments.src: **That's personal selling.**
segments.tr: **वह व्यक्तिगत विक्रय है।**

segments.src: Four tools, one purchase.
segments.tr: चार उपकरण, एक खरीदारी।

segments.src: And notice: if the ad had promised luxury while the email screamed clearance and the salesperson pushed the cheapest floor model, you'd have walked out unsure what this brand even is.
segments.tr: और ध्यान दें: यदि विज्ञापन ने विलासिता का वादा किया होता जबकि ईमेल ने निकासी चिल्लाई थी और विक्रय प्रतिनिधि ने सबसे सस्ते फर्श मॉडल को धकेला था, तो आप यह अनिश्चित होकर बाहर चले गए होते कि यह ब्रांड क्या है।

segments.src: That's the IMC problem in one afternoon.
segments.tr: यह एक दोपहर में IMC समस्या है।

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## तीन-पंक्ति पुनरावृत्ति

segments.src: 1. The promotion mix has four classic tools — advertising, PR, sales promotion, and personal selling — plus direct/digital marketing, and each does a different job.
segments.tr: 1. प्रचार मिश्रण के पास चार क्लासिक उपकरण हैं — विज्ञापन, जनसंपर्क, बिक्री प्रचार, और व्यक्तिगत विक्रय — साथ ही प्रत्यक्ष/डिजिटल विपणन, और प्रत्येक एक अलग काम करता है।

segments.src: 2. Advertising buys reach, PR earns credibility, sales promotion creates urgency, and personal selling closes complexity — which is why the right mix depends on what you sell and to whom.
segments.tr: 2. विज्ञापन पहुंच खरीदता है, PR विश्वसनीयता अर्जित करता है, बिक्री प्रचार आपातकालीनता बनाता है, और व्यक्तिगत विक्रय जटिलता को बंद करता है — इसी कारण सही मिश्रण इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि आप क्या बेचते हैं और किसे।

segments.src: 3. Whatever mix you choose, integrate it: one inconsistent message can undo the budgets behind all the others.
segments.tr: 3. आप जो भी मिश्रण चुनते हैं, इसे एकीकृत करें: एक असंगत संदेश अन्य सभी के पीछे बजट को पूर्ववत कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ स्व-प्रश्नोत्तरी

segments.src: **Q1.** A software company sells a $250,000 annual enterprise contract that requires custom setup and sign-off from four executives.
segments.tr: **Q1।** एक सॉफ्टवेयर कंपनी $250,000 की वार्षिक उद्यम अनुबंध बेचती है जिसे कस्टम सेटअप और चार अधिकारियों से स्वीकृति की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: Which promotion tool should carry the most weight?
segments.tr: किस प्रचार उपकरण को सबसे अधिक वजन ले जाना चाहिए?

segments.src: - A) Television advertising
segments.tr: - A) टेलीविजन विज्ञापन

segments.src: - B) Personal selling
segments.tr: - B) व्यक्तिगत विक्रय

segments.src: - C) Coupons
segments.tr: - C) कूपन

segments.src: - D) Free samples
segments.tr: - D) मुफ्त नमूने

segments.src: **Q2.** True or False — Public relations is essentially free, since you don't pay for the media placement.
segments.tr: **Q2।** सत्य या असत्य — जनसंपर्क अनिवार्य रूप से मुफ्त है, क्योंकि आप मीडिया प्लेसमेंट के लिए भुगतान नहीं करते हैं।

segments.src: **Q3.** A snack brand offers a deep discount every single month.
segments.tr: **Q3।** एक स्नैक ब्रांड हर महीने गहरी छूट प्रदान करता है।

segments.src: What's the most likely long-term risk?
segments.tr: सबसे संभावित दीर्घकालिक जोखिम क्या है?

segments.src: - A) Customers learn to wait for the discount and stop paying full price
segments.tr: - A) ग्राहक छूट के लिए प्रतीक्षा करना सीखते हैं और पूरी कीमत का भुगतान करना बंद करते हैं

segments.src: - B) The product's manufacturing cost rises
segments.tr: - B) उत्पाद की विनिर्माण लागत बढ़ती है

segments.src: - C) Retailers are legally barred from stocking it
segments.tr: - C) खुदरा विक्रेताओं को इसे स्टॉक करने से कानूनी रूप से प्रतिबंधित किया जाता है

segments.src: - D) Advertising becomes impossible
segments.tr: - D) विज्ञापन असंभव हो जाता है

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 आज की शर्तें

segments.src: - **Promotion mix** — the combination of communication tools a company uses to reach and persuade its target market.
segments.tr: - **प्रचार मिश्रण** — संचार उपकरणों का संयोजन जो एक कंपनी अपने लक्ष्य बाजार तक पहुंचने और समझाने के लिए उपयोग करती है।

segments.src: - **Advertising** — any paid, non-personal form of presentation or promotion by an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: - **विज्ञापन** — एक पहचाने गए प्रायोजक द्वारा प्रस्तुतिकरण या प्रचार का कोई भी भुगतान किया गया, गैर-व्यक्तिगत रूप।

segments.src: - **Sales promotion** — a short-term incentive designed to encourage immediate trial or purchase.
segments.tr: - **बिक्री प्रचार** — तत्काल परीक्षण या खरीद को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया एक अल्पकालिक प्रोत्साहन।

segments.src: - **Push vs. pull strategy** — promoting *to the channel* so it stocks and pushes your product, versus promoting *to end customers* so their demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: - **पुश बनाम खींच रणनीति** — *चैनल को* प्रचार करना ताकि यह आपके उत्पाद को स्टॉक और पुश करे, बनाम *अंतिम ग्राहकों को* प्रचार करना ताकि उनकी मांग इसे खींच ले।

segments.src: - **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC)** — coordinating all promotional channels so the brand delivers one clear, consistent message.
segments.tr: - **एकीकृत विपणन संचार (IMC)** — सभी प्रचारक चैनलों को समन्वित करना ताकि ब्रांड एक स्पष्ट, सुसंगत संदेश दे।

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** High-value, complex, multi-stakeholder purchases need two-way conversation, objection handling, and customization.
segments.tr: *उत्तर: **Q1 — B।** उच्च-मूल्य, जटिल, बहु-हितधारक खरीदारी को दो-तरफा बातचीत, आपत्ति संभालने, और अनुकूलन की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: The cost per contact is high, but the deal size easily justifies it.
segments.tr: प्रति संपर्क लागत अधिक है, लेकिन सौदे का आकार आसानी से इसे सही ठहराता है।

segments.src: **Q2 — False.** You don't pay for the placement, but you do pay for PR staff, agencies, events, and time — and unlike advertising, you can't control what actually gets said.
segments.tr: **Q2 — असत्य।** आप प्लेसमेंट के लिए भुगतान नहीं करते हैं, लेकिन आप PR कर्मचारियों, एजेंसियों, घटनाओं, और समय के लिए भुगतान करते हैं — और विज्ञापन के विपरीत, आप यह नियंत्रित नहीं कर सकते कि वास्तव में क्या कहा जाता है।

segments.src: **Q3 — A.** Constant discounting reframes the sale price as the real price.
segments.tr: **Q3 — A।** निरंतर छूट विक्रय मूल्य को वास्तविक मूल्य के रूप में फिर से संरेखित करती है।

segments.src: Customers simply wait, and the brand's perceived value and margins both erode.*
segments.tr: ग्राहक बस प्रतीक्षा करते हैं, और ब्रांड का कथित मूल्य और मार्जिन दोनों नष्ट हो जाते हैं।*

es.title: [Marketing 101 #10] La publicidad, el cupón y el vendedor deben contar todos la misma historia

segments.src: > Promotion isn't just advertising — it's four different tools (advertising, PR, sales promotion, personal selling) that work best when they say one consistent thing.
segments.tr: > La promoción no es solo publicidad — son cuatro herramientas diferentes (publicidad, relaciones públicas, promoción de ventas, venta personal) que funcionan mejor cuando dicen una sola cosa consistente.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concepto de hoy

segments.src: Promotion is the "P" that handles communication.
segments.tr: La promoción es la "P" que maneja la comunicación.

segments.src: You've built a product, priced it, and put it somewhere people can buy it.
segments.tr: Has construido un producto, le has fijado un precio, y lo has puesto en algún lugar donde la gente pueda comprarlo.

segments.src: None of that matters if nobody knows about it, believes it, or has a reason to act this month instead of someday.
segments.tr: Nada de eso importa si nadie lo sabe, lo cree, o tiene una razón para actuar este mes en lugar de algún día.

segments.src: Marketers usually break promotion into four classic tools, each with a different job:
segments.tr: Los especialistas en marketing generalmente dividen la promoción en cuatro herramientas clásicas, cada una con un trabajo diferente:

segments.src: Advertising** — paid, non-personal messaging from an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: Publicidad** — mensajes pagados y no personales de un patrocinador identificado.

segments.src: A streaming-service ad break, a billboard on I-95, a sponsored search result.
segments.tr: Un corte de publicidad de un servicio de transmisión, una valla publicitaria en I-95, un resultado de búsqueda patrocinado.

segments.src: Strength: it reaches enormous numbers of people cheaply *per person*, and you control the message word for word.
segments.tr: Fortaleza: llega a enormes cantidades de personas de forma económica *por persona*, y controlas el mensaje palabra por palabra.

segments.src: Weakness: it's one-way, easy to ignore, and audiences discount it because they know you paid for it.
segments.tr: Debilidad: es unidireccional, fácil de ignorar, y las audiencias lo descuentan porque saben que pagaste por ello.

segments.src: Public relations (PR)** — earning favorable attention rather than buying placement.
segments.tr: Relaciones públicas (RP)** — ganando atención favorable en lugar de comprar colocación.

segments.src: Press outreach, founder interviews, community sponsorships, crisis response.
segments.tr: Contacto con la prensa, entrevistas con fundadores, patrocinios comunitarios, respuesta ante crisis.

segments.src: Strength: high credibility, because a reporter or a neighbor said it, not your ad copy.
segments.tr: Fortaleza: alta credibilidad, porque un reportero o un vecino lo dijo, no tu texto publicitario.

segments.src: Weakness: you don't control it.
segments.tr: Debilidad: no lo controlas.

segments.src: PR isn't free — you pay staff and agencies — you just can't guarantee the outcome.
segments.tr: Las RP no son gratis — pagas personal y agencias — solo que no puedes garantizar el resultado.

segments.src: Sales promotion** — short-term incentives to trigger action *now*.
segments.tr: Promoción de ventas** — incentivos a corto plazo para desencadenar acción *ahora*.

segments.src: Coupons, BOGO, rebates, limited-time bundles, loyalty points, free samples.
segments.tr: Cupones, BOGO, reembolsos, paquetes de tiempo limitado, puntos de fidelización, muestras gratis.

segments.src: Strength: fast, measurable, great for driving trial.
segments.tr: Fortaleza: rápido, medible, excelente para impulsar pruebas.

segments.src: Weakness: it's borrowed demand.
segments.tr: Debilidad: es demanda prestada.

segments.src: Run it too often and you train customers to never pay full price.
segments.tr: Si lo ejecutas demasiado a menudo, entrenas a los clientes a nunca pagar el precio completo.

segments.src: Personal selling** — a human being in a two-way conversation.
segments.tr: Venta personal** — un ser humano en una conversación bidireccional.

segments.src: The salesperson on the floor, the enterprise rep on a call.
segments.tr: El vendedor en la tienda, el representante empresarial en una llamada.

segments.src: Strength: it adapts in real time, handles objections, and closes complicated deals.
segments.tr: Fortaleza: se adapta en tiempo real, maneja objeciones, y cierra acuerdos complicados.

segments.src: Weakness: it's by far the most expensive per contact.
segments.tr: Debilidad: es por mucho el más caro por contacto.

segments.src: Most modern textbooks add a fifth: **direct and digital marketing** — email, SMS, targeted social, direct mail — messages aimed at specific known individuals with a response mechanism built in.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los libros de texto modernos añaden un quinto: **marketing directo y digital** — correo electrónico, SMS, redes sociales dirigidas, correo directo — mensajes dirigidos a individuos específicos conocidos con un mecanismo de respuesta integrado.

segments.src: Two ideas tie the toolkit together.
segments.tr: Dos ideas unen el conjunto de herramientas.

segments.src: **Push vs.
segments.tr: **Empujar vs.

segments.src: pull.** A *push* strategy aims promotion at the channel: trade discounts and sales reps that get retailers to stock and push your product.
segments.tr: tirar.** Una estrategia de *empuje* dirige la promoción hacia el canal: descuentos comerciales y representantes de ventas que logran que los minoristas almacenen e impulsen tu producto.

segments.src: A *pull* strategy aims at the end customer, so they walk in and ask for it by name, and retailers stock it because demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: Una estrategia de *atracción* apunta al cliente final, por lo que entran y lo piden por su nombre, y los minoristas lo almacenan porque la demanda lo impulsa a través.

segments.src: Most companies run both.
segments.tr: La mayoría de las empresas ejecutan ambos.

segments.src: **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC).** Different tools, different budgets, different agencies — but the customer doesn't see departments.
segments.tr: **Comunicaciones de Marketing Integradas (IMC).** Diferentes herramientas, diferentes presupuestos, diferentes agencias — pero el cliente no ve departamentos.

segments.src: They see one brand.
segments.tr: Ven una marca.

segments.src: If your ad says "premium craftsmanship" while your email says "70% OFF — TODAY ONLY," you've spent two budgets to confuse one person.
segments.tr: Si tu anuncio dice "artesanía premium" mientras tu correo electrónico dice "70% DESCUENTO — SOLO HOY," has gastado dos presupuestos para confundir a una persona.

segments.src: IMC just means coordinating every message so they compound instead of cancel.
segments.tr: IMC simplemente significa coordinar cada mensaje para que se componga en lugar de cancelarse.

segments.src: The mix shifts with what you sell.
segments.tr: La mezcla cambia según lo que vendas.

segments.src: Consumer packaged goods — soda, snacks, shampoo — lean heavily on advertising and sales promotion.
segments.tr: Bienes de consumo empaquetados — refrescos, bocadillos, champú — se apoyan fuertemente en publicidad y promoción de ventas.

segments.src: Industrial and B2B products — a $400,000 piece of factory equipment — lean on personal selling, because someone has to answer twenty specific questions before a purchase order gets signed.
segments.tr: Productos industriales y B2B — una pieza de equipo de fábrica de $400,000 — se apoyan en venta personal, porque alguien tiene que responder veinte preguntas específicas antes de que se firme una orden de compra.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## En la vida cotidiana

segments.src: Say it's Saturday in Columbus, Ohio, and you need a new mattress.
segments.tr: Digamos que es sábado en Columbus, Ohio, y necesitas un colchón nuevo.

segments.src: Over coffee you skip a YouTube ad for Restwell Mattress — but you catch the tagline.
segments.tr: Mientras tomas café, omites un anuncio de YouTube para Restwell Mattress — pero capturas el eslogan.

segments.src: **That's advertising.** Paid, controlled, aimed at everyone.
segments.tr: **Eso es publicidad.** Pagado, controlado, dirigido a todos.

segments.src: Scrolling the local news, you see a piece: "Columbus mattress company donates 500 beds to area shelters."
segments.tr: Desplazándote por las noticias locales, ves un artículo: "Empresa de colchones de Columbus dona 500 camas a refugios del área."

segments.src: Nobody paid the *Dispatch* to run that story; the company's PR team pitched it and a reporter thought it was worth covering.
segments.tr: Nadie pagó al *Dispatch* para que publicara esa historia; el equipo de RP de la empresa la presentó y un reportero pensó que valía la pena cubrirla.

segments.src: You trust it more than the ad, precisely because it isn't an ad.
segments.tr: La confías más que el anuncio, precisamente porque no es un anuncio.

segments.src: **That's PR.**
segments.tr: **Eso son RP.**

segments.src: In your inbox: "Presidents' Day Sale — $300 off any queen set, ends Monday."
segments.tr: En tu bandeja de entrada: "Venta del Día de los Presidentes — $300 de descuento en cualquier juego queen, termina el lunes."

segments.src: Nothing about the mattress changed.
segments.tr: Nada del colchón cambió.

segments.src: What changed is that waiting until April now costs you $300.
segments.tr: Lo que cambió es que esperar hasta abril ahora te cuesta $300.

segments.src: **That's sales promotion** — and note the deadline, which is the whole point.
segments.tr: **Eso es promoción de ventas** — y nota la fecha límite, que es el punto completo.

segments.src: You drive over.
segments.tr: Conduces allí.

segments.src: An employee asks how you sleep, hears "my lower back's been rough," and walks you to three medium-firm models between $899 and $1,400 — then throws in free delivery to close it.
segments.tr: Un empleado pregunta cómo duermes, escucha "mi espalda baja ha sido difícil," y te camina a tres modelos de firmeza media entre $899 y $1,400 — luego incluye entrega gratis para cerrarlo.

segments.src: That personalized twenty minutes cost the company far more than the ad impression did, but it's what actually converted the sale.
segments.tr: Esos veinte minutos personalizados le costaron a la empresa mucho más que la impresión del anuncio, pero es lo que realmente convirtió la venta.

segments.src: **That's personal selling.**
segments.tr: **Eso es venta personal.**

segments.src: Four tools, one purchase.
segments.tr: Cuatro herramientas, una compra.

segments.src: And notice: if the ad had promised luxury while the email screamed clearance and the salesperson pushed the cheapest floor model, you'd have walked out unsure what this brand even is.
segments.tr: Y fíjate: si el anuncio hubiera prometido lujo mientras el correo electrónico gritaba liquidación y el vendedor empujaba el modelo de piso más barato, habrías salido sin estar seguro de qué es siquiera esta marca.

segments.src: That's the IMC problem in one afternoon.
segments.tr: Ese es el problema de IMC en una tarde.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumen de tres líneas

segments.src: 1. The promotion mix has four classic tools — advertising, PR, sales promotion, and personal selling — plus direct/digital marketing, and each does a different job.
segments.tr: 1. La mezcla de promoción tiene cuatro herramientas clásicas — publicidad, RP, promoción de ventas, y venta personal — más marketing directo/digital, y cada una hace un trabajo diferente.

segments.src: 2. Advertising buys reach, PR earns credibility, sales promotion creates urgency, and personal selling closes complexity — which is why the right mix depends on what you sell and to whom.
segments.tr: 2. La publicidad compra alcance, las RP ganan credibilidad, la promoción de ventas crea urgencia, y la venta personal cierra la complejidad — por eso la mezcla correcta depende de lo que vendas y a quién.

segments.src: 3. Whatever mix you choose, integrate it: one inconsistent message can undo the budgets behind all the others.
segments.tr: 3. Cualquiera que sea la mezcla que elijas, intégrala: un mensaje inconsistente puede deshacer los presupuestos detrás de todos los demás.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Términos de hoy

segments.src: - **Promotion mix** — the combination of communication tools a company uses to reach and persuade its target market.
segments.tr: - **Mezcla de promoción** — la combinación de herramientas de comunicación que una empresa utiliza para llegar y persuadir a su mercado objetivo.

segments.src: - **Advertising** — any paid, non-personal form of presentation or promotion by an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: - **Publicidad** — cualquier forma pagada y no personal de presentación o promoción por un patrocinador identificado.

segments.src: - **Sales promotion** — a short-term incentive designed to encourage immediate trial or purchase.
segments.tr: - **Promoción de ventas** — un incentivo a corto plazo diseñado para alentar prueba o compra inmediata.

segments.src: - **Push vs. pull strategy** — promoting *to the channel* so it stocks and pushes your product, versus promoting *to end customers* so their demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: - **Estrategia de empuje vs. atracción** — promoviendo *al canal* para que almacene e impulse tu producto, versus promoviendo *a clientes finales* para que su demanda lo impulse a través.

segments.src: - **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC)** — coordinating all promotional channels so the brand delivers one clear, consistent message.
segments.tr: - **Comunicaciones de Marketing Integradas (IMC)** — coordinación de todos los canales promocionales para que la marca entregue un mensaje claro y consistente.

segments.tr: *Respuestas: **P1 — B.** Las compras de alto valor, complejas y con múltiples partes interesadas necesitan conversación bidireccional, manejo de objeciones, y personalización.

segments.src: The cost per contact is high, but the deal size easily justifies it.
segments.tr: El costo por contacto es alto, pero el tamaño del acuerdo lo justifica fácilmente.

segments.tr: **P2 — Falso.** No pagas la colocación, pero sí pagas el personal de RP, agencias, eventos, y tiempo — y a diferencia de la publicidad, no puedes controlar lo que realmente se dice.

segments.src: **Q3 — A.** Constant discounting reframes the sale price as the real price.
segments.tr: **P3 — A.** El descuento constante redefine el precio de venta como el precio real.

fr.title: [Marketing 101 #10] La Publicité, le Coupon et le Commercial Doivent Tous Raconter la Même Histoire

segments.src: > Promotion isn't just advertising — it's four different tools (advertising, PR, sales promotion, personal selling) that work best when they say one consistent thing.
segments.tr: > La promotion n'est pas juste de la publicité — c'est quatre outils différents (publicité, relations publiques, promotion des ventes, vente personnelle) qui fonctionnent mieux quand ils disent une seule chose cohérente.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Le Concept d'Aujourd'hui

segments.src: Promotion is the "P" that handles communication.
segments.tr: La promotion est le « P » qui gère la communication.

segments.src: You've built a product, priced it, and put it somewhere people can buy it.
segments.tr: Vous avez créé un produit, vous l'avez tarifé et vous l'avez mis quelque part où les gens peuvent l'acheter.

segments.src: None of that matters if nobody knows about it, believes it, or has a reason to act this month instead of someday.
segments.tr: Rien de tout cela n'a d'importance si personne ne le sait, ne le croit, ou n'a de raison d'agir ce mois-ci plutôt qu'un jour.

segments.src: Marketers usually break promotion into four classic tools, each with a different job:
segments.tr: Les spécialistes du marketing divisent généralement la promotion en quatre outils classiques, chacun ayant un rôle différent :

segments.src: Advertising** — paid, non-personal messaging from an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: Publicité** — messages payants et impersonnels d'un parrain identifié.

segments.src: A streaming-service ad break, a billboard on I-95, a sponsored search result.
segments.tr: Une pause publicitaire d'un service de streaming, un panneau d'affichage sur l'autoroute I-95, un résultat de recherche sponsorisé.

segments.src: Strength: it reaches enormous numbers of people cheaply *per person*, and you control the message word for word.
segments.tr: Force : elle atteint un énorme nombre de personnes à bas prix *par personne*, et vous contrôlez le message mot pour mot.

segments.src: Weakness: it's one-way, easy to ignore, and audiences discount it because they know you paid for it.
segments.tr: Faiblesse : c'est à sens unique, facile à ignorer, et le public le déduit parce qu'il sait que vous avez payé pour cela.

segments.src: Public relations (PR)** — earning favorable attention rather than buying placement.
segments.tr: Relations publiques (RP)** — gagner une attention favorable plutôt que d'acheter un placement.

segments.src: Press outreach, founder interviews, community sponsorships, crisis response.
segments.tr: Sensibilisation des médias, entretiens avec les fondateurs, partenariats communautaires, réponse aux crises.

segments.src: Strength: high credibility, because a reporter or a neighbor said it, not your ad copy.
segments.tr: Force : crédibilité élevée, parce qu'un journaliste ou un voisin l'a dit, pas votre texte publicitaire.

segments.src: Weakness: you don't control it.
segments.tr: Faiblesse : vous ne la contrôlez pas.

segments.src: PR isn't free — you pay staff and agencies — you just can't guarantee the outcome.
segments.tr: Les RP ne sont pas gratuites — vous payez le personnel et les agences — vous ne pouvez tout simplement pas garantir le résultat.

segments.src: Sales promotion** — short-term incentives to trigger action *now*.
segments.tr: Promotion des ventes** — des incitations à court terme pour déclencher une action *maintenant*.

segments.src: Coupons, BOGO, rebates, limited-time bundles, loyalty points, free samples.
segments.tr: Coupons, BOGO, remises, offres groupées à durée limitée, points de fidélité, échantillons gratuits.

segments.src: Strength: fast, measurable, great for driving trial.
segments.tr: Force : rapide, mesurable, excellente pour promouvoir les essais.

segments.src: Weakness: it's borrowed demand.
segments.tr: Faiblesse : c'est une demande empruntée.

segments.src: Run it too often and you train customers to never pay full price.
segments.tr: Exécutez-le trop souvent et vous entraînez les clients à ne jamais payer le prix fort.

segments.src: Personal selling** — a human being in a two-way conversation.
segments.tr: Vente personnelle** — un être humain dans une conversation bidirectionnelle.

segments.src: The salesperson on the floor, the enterprise rep on a call.
segments.tr: Le vendeur sur le terrain, le représentant d'entreprise lors d'un appel.

segments.src: Strength: it adapts in real time, handles objections, and closes complicated deals.
segments.tr: Force : elle s'adapte en temps réel, gère les objections et conclut les transactions compliquées.

segments.src: Weakness: it's by far the most expensive per contact.
segments.tr: Faiblesse : c'est de loin le plus cher par contact.

segments.src: Most modern textbooks add a fifth: **direct and digital marketing** — email, SMS, targeted social, direct mail — messages aimed at specific known individuals with a response mechanism built in.
segments.tr: La plupart des manuels modernes en ajoutent un cinquième : **le marketing direct et numérique** — e-mail, SMS, réseaux sociaux ciblés, courrier direct — des messages adressés à des individus connus spécifiques avec un mécanisme de réponse intégré.

segments.src: Two ideas tie the toolkit together.
segments.tr: Deux idées lient les outils ensemble.

segments.src: **Push vs.
segments.tr: **Push vs.

segments.src: pull.** A *push* strategy aims promotion at the channel: trade discounts and sales reps that get retailers to stock and push your product.
segments.tr: pull.** Une stratégie *push* vise la promotion vers le canal : les remises commerciales et les représentants commerciaux qui font en sorte que les détaillants stockent et poussent votre produit.

segments.src: A *pull* strategy aims at the end customer, so they walk in and ask for it by name, and retailers stock it because demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: Une stratégie *pull* vise le client final, de sorte qu'il entre et le demande par son nom, et les détaillants le stockent parce que la demande le tire à travers.

segments.src: Most companies run both.
segments.tr: La plupart des entreprises utilisent les deux.

segments.src: **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC).** Different tools, different budgets, different agencies — but the customer doesn't see departments.
segments.tr: **Communications Marketing Intégrées (CMI).** Différents outils, différents budgets, différentes agences — mais le client ne voit pas les départements.

segments.src: They see one brand.
segments.tr: Il voit une seule marque.

segments.src: If your ad says "premium craftsmanship" while your email says "70% OFF — TODAY ONLY," you've spent two budgets to confuse one person.
segments.tr: Si votre annonce dit « savoir-faire premium » tandis que votre e-mail dit « 70% DE RÉDUCTION — AUJOURD'HUI SEULEMENT », vous avez dépensé deux budgets pour confondre une personne.

segments.src: IMC just means coordinating every message so they compound instead of cancel.
segments.tr: CMI signifie simplement coordonner chaque message pour qu'ils s'accumulent plutôt que de s'annuler.

segments.src: The mix shifts with what you sell.
segments.tr: Le mélange change selon ce que vous vendez.

segments.src: Consumer packaged goods — soda, snacks, shampoo — lean heavily on advertising and sales promotion.
segments.tr: Les produits de consommation emballés — sodas, collations, shampoing — s'appuient largement sur la publicité et la promotion des ventes.

segments.src: Industrial and B2B products — a $400,000 piece of factory equipment — lean on personal selling, because someone has to answer twenty specific questions before a purchase order gets signed.
segments.tr: Les produits industriels et B2B — un équipement d'usine de 400 000 $ — s'appuient sur la vente personnelle, parce que quelqu'un doit répondre à vingt questions spécifiques avant qu'un bon de commande soit signé.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la Vie Quotidienne

segments.src: Say it's Saturday in Columbus, Ohio, and you need a new mattress.
segments.tr: Disons que c'est samedi à Columbus, Ohio, et que vous avez besoin d'un nouveau matelas.

segments.src: Over coffee you skip a YouTube ad for Restwell Mattress — but you catch the tagline.
segments.tr: Pendant le café, vous ignorez une annonce YouTube pour Restwell Mattress — mais vous attrapez le slogan.

segments.src: **That's advertising.** Paid, controlled, aimed at everyone.
segments.tr: **C'est de la publicité.** Payée, contrôlée, adressée à tout le monde.

segments.src: Scrolling the local news, you see a piece: "Columbus mattress company donates 500 beds to area shelters."
segments.tr: En consultant les nouvelles locales, vous voyez un article : « Une entreprise de matelas de Columbus donne 500 lits aux refuges de la région. »

segments.src: Nobody paid the *Dispatch* to run that story; the company's PR team pitched it and a reporter thought it was worth covering.
segments.tr: Personne n'a payé le *Dispatch* pour publier cette histoire ; l'équipe de relations publiques de l'entreprise l'a lancée et un journaliste a pensé qu'elle valait la peine d'être couverte.

segments.src: You trust it more than the ad, precisely because it isn't an ad.
segments.tr: Vous lui faites davantage confiance qu'à l'annonce, précisément parce que ce n'est pas une annonce.

segments.src: **That's PR.**
segments.tr: **C'est des relations publiques.**

segments.src: In your inbox: "Presidents' Day Sale — $300 off any queen set, ends Monday."
segments.tr: Dans votre boîte de réception : « Vente de la Journée du Président — 300 $ de réduction sur tout ensemble queen, se termine lundi. »

segments.src: Nothing about the mattress changed.
segments.tr: Rien n'a changé au sujet du matelas.

segments.src: What changed is that waiting until April now costs you $300.
segments.tr: Ce qui a changé, c'est que l'attente jusqu'en avril vous coûte maintenant 300 $.

segments.src: **That's sales promotion** — and note the deadline, which is the whole point.
segments.tr: **C'est la promotion des ventes** — et notez la date limite, qui est tout le point.

segments.src: You drive over.
segments.tr: Vous conduisez.

segments.src: An employee asks how you sleep, hears "my lower back's been rough," and walks you to three medium-firm models between $899 and $1,400 — then throws in free delivery to close it.
segments.tr: Un employé demande comment vous dormez, entend « mon bas du dos a été rude », et vous guide vers trois modèles mi-fermes entre 899 $ et 1 400 $ — puis ajoute une livraison gratuite pour le conclure.

segments.src: That personalized twenty minutes cost the company far more than the ad impression did, but it's what actually converted the sale.
segments.tr: Ces vingt minutes personnalisées ont coûté à l'entreprise bien plus que l'impression de l'annonce, mais c'est ce qui a réellement converti la vente.

segments.src: **That's personal selling.**
segments.tr: **C'est de la vente personnelle.**

segments.src: Four tools, one purchase.
segments.tr: Quatre outils, un achat.

segments.src: And notice: if the ad had promised luxury while the email screamed clearance and the salesperson pushed the cheapest floor model, you'd have walked out unsure what this brand even is.
segments.tr: Et notez : si l'annonce avait promis le luxe tandis que l'e-mail criait liquidation et que le vendeur poussait le modèle d'étage le moins cher, vous seriez parti sans savoir ce qu'est cette marque.

segments.src: That's the IMC problem in one afternoon.
segments.tr: C'est le problème CMI en une après-midi.

pt.title: [Marketing 101 #10] O Anúncio, o Cupom e o Vendedor Devem Contar a Mesma História

segments.src: > Promotion isn't just advertising — it's four different tools (advertising, PR, sales promotion, personal selling) that work best when they say one consistent thing.
segments.tr: > Promoção não é apenas publicidade — são quatro ferramentas diferentes (publicidade, Relações Públicas, promoção de vendas, venda pessoal) que funcionam melhor quando comunicam uma coisa consistente.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## O Conceito de Hoje

segments.src: Promotion is the "P" that handles communication.
segments.tr: Promoção é o "P" que lida com comunicação.

segments.src: You've built a product, priced it, and put it somewhere people can buy it.
segments.tr: Você construiu um produto, precificou e o colocou em um lugar onde as pessoas podem comprá-lo.

segments.src: None of that matters if nobody knows about it, believes it, or has a reason to act this month instead of someday.
segments.tr: Nada disso importa se ninguém sabe sobre isso, acredita ou tem um motivo para agir este mês em vez de algum dia.

segments.src: Marketers usually break promotion into four classic tools, each with a different job:
segments.tr: Profissionais de marketing geralmente dividem promoção em quatro ferramentas clássicas, cada uma com um trabalho diferente:

segments.src: Advertising** — paid, non-personal messaging from an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: Publicidade** — mensagens pagas e impessoais de um patrocinador identificado.

segments.src: A streaming-service ad break, a billboard on I-95, a sponsored search result.
segments.tr: Um intervalo publicitário de serviço de streaming, um painel em I-95, um resultado de pesquisa patrocinado.

segments.src: Strength: it reaches enormous numbers of people cheaply *per person*, and you control the message word for word.
segments.tr: Força: alcança um número enorme de pessoas barato *por pessoa*, e você controla a mensagem palavra por palavra.

segments.src: Weakness: it's one-way, easy to ignore, and audiences discount it because they know you paid for it.
segments.tr: Fraqueza: é unidirecional, fácil de ignorar, e o público desconta porque sabe que você pagou por isso.

segments.src: Public relations (PR)** — earning favorable attention rather than buying placement.
segments.tr: Relações Públicas (RP)** — ganhar atenção favorável em vez de comprar colocação.

segments.src: Press outreach, founder interviews, community sponsorships, crisis response.
segments.tr: Alcance à imprensa, entrevistas com fundadores, patrocínios comunitários, resposta a crises.

segments.src: Strength: high credibility, because a reporter or a neighbor said it, not your ad copy.
segments.tr: Força: alta credibilidade, porque um repórter ou vizinho disse isso, não seu texto publicitário.

segments.src: Weakness: you don't control it.
segments.tr: Fraqueza: você não controla isso.

segments.src: PR isn't free — you pay staff and agencies — you just can't guarantee the outcome.
segments.tr: RP não é gratuita — você paga funcionários e agências — você apenas não consegue garantir o resultado.

segments.src: Sales promotion** — short-term incentives to trigger action *now*.
segments.tr: Promoção de vendas** — incentivos de curto prazo para desencadear ação *agora*.

segments.src: Coupons, BOGO, rebates, limited-time bundles, loyalty points, free samples.
segments.tr: Cupons, BOGO, reembolsos, pacotes por tempo limitado, pontos de fidelidade, amostras grátis.

segments.src: Strength: fast, measurable, great for driving trial.
segments.tr: Força: rápido, mensurável, ótimo para impulsionar testes.

segments.src: Weakness: it's borrowed demand.
segments.tr: Fraqueza: é demanda emprestada.

segments.src: Run it too often and you train customers to never pay full price.
segments.tr: Execute com muita frequência e você treina os clientes a nunca pagar o preço total.

segments.src: Personal selling** — a human being in a two-way conversation.
segments.tr: Venda pessoal** — um ser humano em uma conversa bidirecional.

segments.src: The salesperson on the floor, the enterprise rep on a call.
segments.tr: O vendedor no piso, o representante da empresa em uma chamada.

segments.src: Strength: it adapts in real time, handles objections, and closes complicated deals.
segments.tr: Força: se adapta em tempo real, lida com objeções e fecha negócios complicados.

segments.src: Weakness: it's by far the most expensive per contact.
segments.tr: Fraqueza: é de longe o mais caro por contato.

segments.src: Most modern textbooks add a fifth: **direct and digital marketing** — email, SMS, targeted social, direct mail — messages aimed at specific known individuals with a response mechanism built in.
segments.tr: A maioria dos manuais modernos adiciona um quinto: **marketing direto e digital** — email, SMS, redes sociais direcionadas, mala direta — mensagens direcionadas a indivíduos específicos e conhecidos com um mecanismo de resposta incorporado.

segments.src: Two ideas tie the toolkit together.
segments.tr: Duas ideias unem o kit de ferramentas.

segments.src: **Push vs.
segments.tr: **Empurrar vs.

segments.src: pull.** A *push* strategy aims promotion at the channel: trade discounts and sales reps that get retailers to stock and push your product.
segments.tr: puxar.** Uma estratégia de *empurrar* visa promoção no canal: descontos comerciais e representantes de vendas que levam varejistas a estocar e empurrar seu produto.

segments.src: A *pull* strategy aims at the end customer, so they walk in and ask for it by name, and retailers stock it because demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: Uma estratégia de *puxar* visa o cliente final, para que ele entre e peça pelo nome, e os varejistas o estoquem porque a demanda o puxa.

segments.src: Most companies run both.
segments.tr: A maioria das empresas executa ambas.

segments.src: **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC).** Different tools, different budgets, different agencies — but the customer doesn't see departments.
segments.tr: **Comunicação Integrada de Marketing (CIM).** Ferramentas diferentes, orçamentos diferentes, agências diferentes — mas o cliente não vê departamentos.

segments.src: They see one brand.
segments.tr: Eles veem uma marca.

segments.src: If your ad says "premium craftsmanship" while your email says "70% OFF — TODAY ONLY," you've spent two budgets to confuse one person.
segments.tr: Se seu anúncio diz "artesanato premium" enquanto seu email diz "70% OFF — APENAS HOJE," você gastou dois orçamentos para confundir uma pessoa.

segments.src: IMC just means coordinating every message so they compound instead of cancel.
segments.tr: CIM apenas significa coordenar cada mensagem para que se componham em vez de se cancelarem.

segments.src: The mix shifts with what you sell.
segments.tr: O mix muda com o que você vende.

segments.src: Consumer packaged goods — soda, snacks, shampoo — lean heavily on advertising and sales promotion.
segments.tr: Bens de consumo embalados — refrigerante, lanches, xampu — dependem fortemente de publicidade e promoção de vendas.

segments.src: Industrial and B2B products — a $400,000 piece of factory equipment — lean on personal selling, because someone has to answer twenty specific questions before a purchase order gets signed.
segments.tr: Produtos industriais e B2B — um equipamento de fábrica de $400.000 — dependem de venda pessoal, porque alguém precisa responder vinte perguntas específicas antes de um pedido de compra ser assinado.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Na Vida Cotidiana

segments.src: Say it's Saturday in Columbus, Ohio, and you need a new mattress.
segments.tr: Digamos que é sábado em Columbus, Ohio, e você precisa de um novo colchão.

segments.src: Over coffee you skip a YouTube ad for Restwell Mattress — but you catch the tagline.
segments.tr: Durante o café, você pula um anúncio do YouTube para Restwell Mattress — mas você pega a frase de efeito.

segments.src: **That's advertising.** Paid, controlled, aimed at everyone.
segments.tr: **Isso é publicidade.** Paga, controlada, direcionada a todos.

segments.src: Scrolling the local news, you see a piece: "Columbus mattress company donates 500 beds to area shelters."
segments.tr: Rolando as notícias locais, você vê uma reportagem: "Empresa de colchão Columbus doa 500 camas para abrigos da área."

segments.src: Nobody paid the *Dispatch* to run that story; the company's PR team pitched it and a reporter thought it was worth covering.
segments.tr: Ninguém pagou ao *Dispatch* para veicular essa história; a equipe de RP da empresa a apresentou e um repórter achou que valia a pena cobrir.

segments.src: You trust it more than the ad, precisely because it isn't an ad.
segments.tr: Você confia nele mais do que no anúncio, precisamente porque não é um anúncio.

segments.src: **That's PR.**
segments.tr: **Isso é RP.**

segments.src: In your inbox: "Presidents' Day Sale — $300 off any queen set, ends Monday."
segments.tr: Na sua caixa de entrada: "Venda do Dia dos Presidentes — $300 de desconto em qualquer conjunto queen, termina segunda-feira."

segments.src: Nothing about the mattress changed.
segments.tr: Nada sobre o colchão mudou.

segments.src: What changed is that waiting until April now costs you $300.
segments.tr: O que mudou é que esperar até abril agora custa $300.

segments.src: **That's sales promotion** — and note the deadline, which is the whole point.
segments.tr: **Isso é promoção de vendas** — e observe o prazo, que é o ponto todo.

segments.src: You drive over.
segments.tr: Você dirige para lá.

segments.src: An employee asks how you sleep, hears "my lower back's been rough," and walks you to three medium-firm models between $899 and $1,400 — then throws in free delivery to close it.
segments.tr: Um funcionário pergunta como você dorme, ouve "minhas costas inferiores têm sido difíceis," e o leva a três modelos firmes no meio entre $899 e $1.400 — depois oferece entrega gratuita para fechar.

segments.src: That personalized twenty minutes cost the company far more than the ad impression did, but it's what actually converted the sale.
segments.tr: Esses vinte minutos personalizados custaram à empresa muito mais do que a impressão do anúncio fez, mas foi isso que realmente converteu a venda.

segments.src: **That's personal selling.**
segments.tr: **Isso é venda pessoal.**

segments.src: Four tools, one purchase.
segments.tr: Quatro ferramentas, uma compra.

segments.src: And notice: if the ad had promised luxury while the email screamed clearance and the salesperson pushed the cheapest floor model, you'd have walked out unsure what this brand even is.
segments.tr: E observe: se o anúncio tivesse prometido luxo enquanto o email gritasse liquidação e o vendedor empurrasse o modelo de piso mais barato, você teria saído sem saber o que essa marca é.

segments.src: That's the IMC problem in one afternoon.
segments.tr: Esse é o problema do CIM em uma tarde.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumo de Três Linhas

segments.src: 1. The promotion mix has four classic tools — advertising, PR, sales promotion, and personal selling — plus direct/digital marketing, and each does a different job.
segments.tr: 1. O mix de promoção tem quatro ferramentas clássicas — publicidade, RP, promoção de vendas e venda pessoal — mais marketing direto/digital, e cada uma faz um trabalho diferente.

segments.src: 2. Advertising buys reach, PR earns credibility, sales promotion creates urgency, and personal selling closes complexity — which is why the right mix depends on what you sell and to whom.
segments.tr: 2. Publicidade compra alcance, RP ganha credibilidade, promoção de vendas cria urgência e venda pessoal encerra complexidade — é por isso que o mix certo depende do que você vende e para quem.

segments.src: 3. Whatever mix you choose, integrate it: one inconsistent message can undo the budgets behind all the others.
segments.tr: 3. Qualquer mix que você escolha, integre: uma mensagem inconsistente pode desfazer os orçamentos atrás de todos os outros.
