segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termos de Hoje

segments.src: - **Promotion mix** — the combination of communication tools a company uses to reach and persuade its target market.
segments.tr: - **Mix de promoção** — a combinação de ferramentas de comunicação que uma empresa usa para alcançar e persuadir seu mercado-alvo.

segments.src: - **Advertising** — any paid, non-personal form of presentation or promotion by an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: - **Publicidade** — qualquer forma paga e impessoal de apresentação ou promoção por um patrocinador identificado.

segments.src: - **Sales promotion** — a short-term incentive designed to encourage immediate trial or purchase.
segments.tr: - **Promoção de vendas** — um incentivo de curto prazo projetado para encorajar tentativa ou compra imediata.

segments.src: - **Push vs. pull strategy** — promoting *to the channel* so it stocks and pushes your product, versus promoting *to end customers* so their demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: - **Estratégia de empurrar vs. puxar** — promover *para o canal* para que estoque e empurre seu produto, versus promover *para clientes finais* para que sua demanda o puxe.

segments.src: - **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC)** — coordinating all promotional channels so the brand delivers one clear, consistent message.
segments.tr: - **Comunicação Integrada de Marketing (CIM)** — coordenar todos os canais promocionais para que a marca entregue uma mensagem clara e consistente.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** High-value, complex, multi-stakeholder purchases need two-way conversation, objection handling, and customization.
segments.tr: *Respostas: **P1 — B.** Compras de alto valor, complexas e com múltiplas partes interessadas precisam de conversa bidirecional, tratamento de objeções e personalização.

segments.src: The cost per contact is high, but the deal size easily justifies it.
segments.tr: O custo por contato é alto, mas o tamanho do negócio facilmente justifica.

segments.src: **Q2 — False.** You don't pay for the placement, but you do pay for PR staff, agencies, events, and time — and unlike advertising, you can't control what actually gets said.
segments.tr: **P2 — Falso.** Você não paga pelo posicionamento, mas paga por equipe de RP, agências, eventos e tempo — e diferente da publicidade, você não consegue controlar o que realmente é dito.

segments.src: **Q3 — A.** Constant discounting reframes the sale price as the real price.
segments.tr: **P3 — A.** Descontos constantes reformulam o preço de venda como o preço real.

segments.src: Customers simply wait, and the brand's perceived value and margins both erode.*
segments.tr: Os clientes simplesmente esperam, e o valor percebido da marca e as margens são erodidos.*

segments.tr: Katakanlah hari Sabtu di Columbus, Ohio, dan Anda membutuhkan kasur baru.

segments.src: Over coffee you skip a YouTube ad for Restwell Mattress — but you catch the tagline.
segments.tr: Di atas kopi Anda melewatkan iklan YouTube untuk Restwell Mattress — tetapi Anda menangkap tagline.

segments.src: **That's advertising.** Paid, controlled, aimed at everyone.
segments.tr: **Itu iklan.** Berbayar, dikendalikan, ditujukan kepada semua orang.

segments.src: Scrolling the local news, you see a piece: "Columbus mattress company donates 500 beds to area shelters."
segments.tr: Menggulir berita lokal, Anda melihat tulisan: "Perusahaan kasur Columbus menyumbangkan 500 tempat tidur ke tempat penampungan daerah."

segments.src: Nobody paid the *Dispatch* to run that story; the company's PR team pitched it and a reporter thought it was worth covering.
segments.tr: Tidak ada yang membayar *Dispatch* untuk menjalankan cerita itu; tim PR perusahaan mengajukannya dan seorang reporter menganggapnya layak diliput.

segments.src: You trust it more than the ad, precisely because it isn't an ad.
segments.tr: Anda mempercayainya lebih dari iklan, tepatnya karena itu bukan iklan.

segments.src: **That's PR.**
segments.tr: **Itu PR.**

segments.src: In your inbox: "Presidents' Day Sale — $300 off any queen set, ends Monday."
segments.tr: Di kotak masuk Anda: "Penjualan Hari Presiden — $300 diskon untuk set queen apa pun, berakhir Senin."

segments.src: Nothing about the mattress changed.
segments.tr: Tidak ada yang berubah tentang kasur.

segments.src: What changed is that waiting until April now costs you $300.
segments.tr: Yang berubah adalah menunggu sampai April sekarang biaya Anda $300.

segments.src: **That's sales promotion** — and note the deadline, which is the whole point.
segments.tr: **Itu promosi penjualan** — dan perhatikan tenggat waktu, yang merupakan seluruh poin.

segments.src: You drive over.
segments.tr: Anda berkendara.

segments.src: An employee asks how you sleep, hears "my lower back's been rough," and walks you to three medium-firm models between $899 and $1,400 — then throws in free delivery to close it.
segments.tr: Seorang karyawan menanyakan bagaimana Anda tidur, mendengar "punggung bagian bawah saya terasa sakit," dan membawa Anda ke tiga model sedang-keras antara $899 dan $1.400 — kemudian memberikan pengiriman gratis untuk menutupnya.

segments.src: That personalized twenty minutes cost the company far more than the ad impression did, but it's what actually converted the sale.
segments.tr: Dua puluh menit yang dipersonalisasi itu biaya perusahaan jauh lebih banyak daripada tayangan iklan, tetapi itulah yang benar-benar mengkonversi penjualan.

segments.src: **That's personal selling.**
segments.tr: **Itu penjualan personal.**

segments.src: Four tools, one purchase.
segments.tr: Empat alat, satu pembelian.

segments.src: And notice: if the ad had promised luxury while the email screamed clearance and the salesperson pushed the cheapest floor model, you'd have walked out unsure what this brand even is.
segments.tr: Dan perhatikan: jika iklan telah menjanjikan kemewahan sementara email berteriak clearance dan tenaga penjual mendorong model lantai termurah, Anda akan keluar tidak yakin apa merek ini bahkan.

segments.src: That's the IMC problem in one afternoon.
segments.tr: **Itu adalah masalah IMC dalam satu sore.**

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan Tiga Baris

segments.src: 1. The promotion mix has four classic tools — advertising, PR, sales promotion, and personal selling — plus direct/digital marketing, and each does a different job.
segments.tr: 1. Bauran promosi memiliki empat alat klasik — iklan, PR, promosi penjualan, dan penjualan personal — ditambah pemasaran langsung/digital, dan masing-masing melakukan pekerjaan yang berbeda.

segments.src: 2. Advertising buys reach, PR earns credibility, sales promotion creates urgency, and personal selling closes complexity — which is why the right mix depends on what you sell and to whom.
segments.tr: 2. Iklan membeli jangkauan, PR mendapatkan kredibilitas, promosi penjualan menciptakan urgensi, dan penjualan personal menutup kompleksitas — itulah mengapa bauran yang tepat tergantung pada apa yang Anda jual dan kepada siapa.

segments.src: 3. Whatever mix you choose, integrate it: one inconsistent message can undo the budgets behind all the others.
segments.tr: 3. Apa pun bauran yang Anda pilih, integrasikan: satu pesan yang tidak konsisten dapat membatalkan anggaran di balik semua yang lain.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

segments.src: - **Promotion mix** — the combination of communication tools a company uses to reach and persuade its target market.
segments.tr: - **Bauran promosi** — kombinasi alat komunikasi yang digunakan perusahaan untuk menjangkau dan membujuk target pasarnya.

segments.src: - **Advertising** — any paid, non-personal form of presentation or promotion by an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: - **Iklan** — bentuk presentasi atau promosi berbayar, non-personal apa pun oleh sponsor yang diidentifikasi.

segments.src: - **Sales promotion** — a short-term incentive designed to encourage immediate trial or purchase.
segments.tr: - **Promosi penjualan** — insentif jangka pendek yang dirancang untuk mendorong percobaan atau pembelian segera.

segments.src: - **Push vs. pull strategy** — promoting *to the channel* so it stocks and pushes your product, versus promoting *to end customers* so their demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: - **Strategi push vs. pull** — mempromosikan *ke saluran* sehingga ia menyimpan dan mendorong produk Anda, versus mempromosikan *ke pelanggan akhir* sehingga permintaan mereka menariknya.

segments.src: - **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC)** — coordinating all promotional channels so the brand delivers one clear, consistent message.
segments.tr: - **Komunikasi Pemasaran Terpadu (IMC)** — mengoordinasikan semua saluran promosi sehingga merek memberikan satu pesan yang jelas dan konsisten.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** High-value, complex, multi-stakeholder purchases need two-way conversation, objection handling, and customization.
segments.tr: *Jawaban: **Q1 — B.** Pembelian bernilai tinggi, kompleks, multi-pemangku kepentingan memerlukan percakapan dua arah, penanganan keberatan, dan kustomisasi.

segments.src: The cost per contact is high, but the deal size easily justifies it.
segments.tr: Biaya per kontak tinggi, tetapi ukuran kesepakatan dengan mudah membenarkannya.

segments.src: **Q2 — False.** You don't pay for the placement, but you do pay for PR staff, agencies, events, and time — and unlike advertising, you can't control what actually gets said.
segments.tr: **Q2 — Salah.** Anda tidak membayar penempatan, tetapi Anda membayar staf PR, agensi, acara, dan waktu — dan tidak seperti iklan, Anda tidak dapat mengendalikan apa yang sebenarnya dikatakan.

segments.src: **Q3 — A.** Constant discounting reframes the sale price as the real price.
segments.tr: **Q3 — A.** Diskon konstan mengubah kerangka harga jual sebagai harga nyata.

segments.src: Customers simply wait, and the brand's perceived value and margins both erode.*
segments.tr: Pelanggan hanya menunggu, dan nilai yang dirasakan merek dan margin keduanya terkikis.*

ja.title: 【マーケティング 101 #10】広告、クーポン、営業担当者は同じストーリーを語るべき

segments.src: > Promotion isn't just advertising — it's four different tools (advertising, PR, sales promotion, personal selling) that work best when they say one consistent thing.
segments.tr: > プロモーションは単なる広告ではなく、一つの一貫したメッセージを伝えるときに最も効果的な4つの異なるツール（広告、パブリックリレーション、セールスプロモーション、個人売買）です。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日のコンセプト

segments.src: Promotion is the "P" that handles communication.
segments.tr: プロモーションはコミュニケーションを扱う「P」です。

segments.src: You've built a product, priced it, and put it somewhere people can buy it.
segments.tr: あなたは製品を開発し、価格設定し、人々が購入できる場所に配置しました。

segments.src: None of that matters if nobody knows about it, believes it, or has a reason to act this month instead of someday.
segments.tr: もし誰もそれについて知らず、信じず、いつかではなく今月行動する理由がなければ、それらのどれも重要ではありません。

segments.src: Marketers usually break promotion into four classic tools, each with a different job:
segments.tr: マーケターは通常、プロモーションを4つの古典的なツールに分けます。それぞれが異なる役割を持っています:

segments.src: Advertising** — paid, non-personal messaging from an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: 広告** — 特定されたスポンサーからの有料で非個人的なメッセージング。

segments.src: A streaming-service ad break, a billboard on I-95, a sponsored search result.
segments.tr: ストリーミングサービスの広告ブレーク、I-95上の看板、スポンサー付き検索結果。

segments.src: Strength: it reaches enormous numbers of people cheaply *per person*, and you control the message word for word.
segments.tr: 強み：膨大な数の人々に*1人あたり*低いコストで到達でき、メッセージを完全にコントロールできます。

segments.src: Weakness: it's one-way, easy to ignore, and audiences discount it because they know you paid for it.
segments.tr: 弱み：一方向的で、無視しやすく、視聴者はあなたがそれに支払ったことを知っているため割り引きます。

segments.src: Public relations (PR)** — earning favorable attention rather than buying placement.
segments.tr: パブリックリレーション（PR）** — プレイスメントを購入するのではなく、好意的な注目を獲得することです。

segments.src: Press outreach, founder interviews, community sponsorships, crisis response.
segments.tr: プレスアウトリーチ、創業者インタビュー、コミュニティスポンサーシップ、危機管理。

segments.src: Strength: high credibility, because a reporter or a neighbor said it, not your ad copy.
segments.tr: 強み：記者や近所の人があなたの広告コピーではなくそれを述べたため、高い信頼性があります。

segments.src: Weakness: you don't control it.
segments.tr: 弱み：あなたはそれをコントロールできません。

segments.src: PR isn't free — you pay staff and agencies — you just can't guarantee the outcome.
segments.tr: PRは無料ではありません。あなたはスタッフと代理店に支払います。結果を保証することはできません。

segments.src: Sales promotion** — short-term incentives to trigger action *now*.
segments.tr: セールスプロモーション** — 今*すぐに*行動を起こすための短期的なインセンティブです。

segments.src: Coupons, BOGO, rebates, limited-time bundles, loyalty points, free samples.
segments.tr: クーポン、BOGO、リベート、期間限定バンドル、ロイヤリティポイント、無料サンプル。

segments.src: Strength: fast, measurable, great for driving trial.
segments.tr: 強み：速く、測定可能で、試行運転の促進に優れています。

segments.src: Weakness: it's borrowed demand.
segments.tr: 弱み：それは借り入れた需要です。

segments.src: Run it too often and you train customers to never pay full price.
segments.tr: 頻繁に実行しすぎると、顧客は定価を支払わないように条件付けられます。

segments.src: Personal selling** — a human being in a two-way conversation.
segments.tr: 個人売買** — 双方向の会話における人間です。

segments.src: The salesperson on the floor, the enterprise rep on a call.
segments.tr: フロアの営業担当者、通話中のエンタープライズ担当者。

segments.src: Strength: it adapts in real time, handles objections, and closes complicated deals.
segments.tr: 強み：リアルタイムで適応し、異議を処理し、複雑な取引を成立させます。

segments.src: Weakness: it's by far the most expensive per contact.
segments.tr: 弱み：接触あたり最も高額です。

segments.src: Most modern textbooks add a fifth: **direct and digital marketing** — email, SMS, targeted social, direct mail — messages aimed at specific known individuals with a response mechanism built in.
segments.tr: ほとんどの現代教科書は5番目を追加しています：**ダイレクト・デジタルマーケティング** — メール、SMS、ターゲット化されたソーシャル、ダイレクトメール — 応答メカニズムが組み込まれた特定の既知個人を対象としたメッセージです。

segments.src: Two ideas tie the toolkit together.
segments.tr: 2つのアイデアがツールキットを結びつけます。

segments.src: **Push vs.
segments.tr: **プッシュ対

segments.src: pull.** A *push* strategy aims promotion at the channel: trade discounts and sales reps that get retailers to stock and push your product.
segments.tr: プル。** *プッシュ*戦略はチャネルに向けてプロモーションを目指します：小売業者があなたの製品をストックして推進するための取引割引と営業担当者です。

segments.src: A *pull* strategy aims at the end customer, so they walk in and ask for it by name, and retailers stock it because demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: *プル*戦略は最終顧客を対象としているため、彼らは歩いて入ってきて名前で要求し、小売業者は需要がそれを引き抜くためストックします。

segments.src: Most companies run both.
segments.tr: ほとんどの企業は両方を実行しています。

segments.src: **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC).** Different tools, different budgets, different agencies — but the customer doesn't see departments.
segments.tr: **統合マーケティング・コミュニケーション（IMC）。** 異なるツール、異なる予算、異なる代理店です。しかし顧客は部門を見ません。

segments.src: They see one brand.
segments.tr: 彼らは1つのブランドを見ます。

segments.src: If your ad says "premium craftsmanship" while your email says "70% OFF — TODAY ONLY," you've spent two budgets to confuse one person.
segments.tr: あなたの広告が「プレミアム工芸品」と言っている一方で、あなたのメールが「70％オフ — 本日のみ」と言っている場合、1人の人を混乱させるために2つの予算を費やしてしまっています。

segments.src: IMC just means coordinating every message so they compound instead of cancel.
segments.tr: IMCは単に、メッセージをキャンセルするのではなく複合させるようにすべてのメッセージを調整することを意味します。

segments.src: The mix shifts with what you sell.
segments.tr: ミックスはあなたが売るものによって変わります。

segments.src: Consumer packaged goods — soda, snacks, shampoo — lean heavily on advertising and sales promotion.
segments.tr: 消費者向けパッケージ商品 — ソーダ、スナック、シャンプー — は広告とセールスプロモーションに大きく依存します。

segments.src: Industrial and B2B products — a $400,000 piece of factory equipment — lean on personal selling, because someone has to answer twenty specific questions before a purchase order gets signed.
segments.tr: 産業およびB2B製品 — 400,000ドルの工場機器 — は個人売買に依存します。なぜなら、購入発注書に署名される前に誰かが20の具体的な質問に答える必要があるからです。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 3行の要約

segments.src: 1. The promotion mix has four classic tools — advertising, PR, sales promotion, and personal selling — plus direct/digital marketing, and each does a different job.
segments.tr: 1. プロモーションミックスは4つの古典的なツール — 広告、PR、セールスプロモーション、個人売買 — に加えてダイレクト/デジタルマーケティングがあり、それぞれ異なる役割を果たします。

segments.src: 3. Whatever mix you choose, integrate it: one inconsistent message can undo the budgets behind all the others.
segments.tr: 3. どのミックスを選択しても、それを統合してください：1つの矛盾したメッセージはすべての他の予算を台無しにすることができます。

de.title: [Marketing 101 #10] Die Anzeige, der Gutschein und der Verkäufer sollten alle dieselbe Geschichte erzählen

segments.src: > Promotion isn't just advertising — it's four different tools (advertising, PR, sales promotion, personal selling) that work best when they say one consistent thing.
segments.tr: > Förderung ist nicht nur Werbung — es sind vier verschiedene Werkzeuge (Werbung, PR, Verkaufsförderung, persönlicher Verkauf), die am besten funktionieren, wenn sie konsistent dieselbe Botschaft vermitteln.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Heutiges Konzept

segments.src: Promotion is the "P" that handles communication.
segments.tr: Promotion ist das "P", das die Kommunikation handhabt.

segments.src: You've built a product, priced it, and put it somewhere people can buy it.
segments.tr: Sie haben ein Produkt entwickelt, es bepreist und es irgendwo platziert, wo Menschen es kaufen können.

segments.src: None of that matters if nobody knows about it, believes it, or has a reason to act this month instead of someday.
segments.tr: Nichts davon ist von Bedeutung, wenn niemand davon weiß, es glaubt oder einen Grund hat, diesen Monat zu handeln, anstatt irgendwann.

segments.src: Marketers usually break promotion into four classic tools, each with a different job:
segments.tr: Vermarkter unterteilen Förderung normalerweise in vier klassische Werkzeuge, von denen jedes eine andere Aufgabe hat:

segments.src: Advertising** — paid, non-personal messaging from an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: Werbung** — bezahlte, unpersönliche Botschaften von einem identifizierten Sponsor.

segments.src: A streaming-service ad break, a billboard on I-95, a sponsored search result.
segments.tr: Eine Werbepause bei einem Streaming-Dienst, ein Plakat auf der I-95, ein gesponsertes Suchergebnis.

segments.src: Strength: it reaches enormous numbers of people cheaply *per person*, and you control the message word for word.
segments.tr: Stärke: Sie erreicht eine riesige Anzahl von Menschen günstig *pro Person*, und Sie kontrollieren die Botschaft Wort für Wort.

segments.src: Weakness: it's one-way, easy to ignore, and audiences discount it because they know you paid for it.
segments.tr: Schwäche: Sie ist einseitig, leicht zu ignorieren, und das Publikum diskontiert sie, weil es weiß, dass Sie dafür bezahlt haben.

segments.src: Public relations (PR)** — earning favorable attention rather than buying placement.
segments.tr: Öffentlichkeitsarbeit (PR)** — wohlwollende Aufmerksamkeit zu verdienen, anstatt Platzierung zu kaufen.

segments.src: Press outreach, founder interviews, community sponsorships, crisis response.
segments.tr: Pressearbeit, Gründerinterviews, Community-Sponsorships, Krisenkommunikation.

segments.src: Strength: high credibility, because a reporter or a neighbor said it, not your ad copy.
segments.tr: Stärke: hohe Glaubwürdigkeit, weil ein Reporter oder ein Nachbar es sagte, nicht Ihre Anzeigentexte.

segments.src: Weakness: you don't control it.
segments.tr: Schwäche: Sie kontrollieren sie nicht.

segments.src: PR isn't free — you pay staff and agencies — you just can't guarantee the outcome.
segments.tr: PR ist nicht kostenlos — Sie zahlen für Personal und Agenturen — Sie können nur das Ergebnis nicht garantieren.

segments.src: Sales promotion** — short-term incentives to trigger action *now*.
segments.tr: Verkaufsförderung** — kurzfristige Anreize, um *sofortige* Maßnahmen auszulösen.

segments.src: Coupons, BOGO, rebates, limited-time bundles, loyalty points, free samples.
segments.tr: Gutscheine, BOGO, Rabatte, zeitlich begrenzte Bundles, Treuepunkte, kostenlose Muster.

segments.src: Strength: fast, measurable, great for driving trial.
segments.tr: Stärke: schnell, messbar, großartig für die Förderung von Proben.

segments.src: Weakness: it's borrowed demand.
segments.tr: Schwäche: Es ist geliehene Nachfrage.

segments.src: Run it too often and you train customers to never pay full price.
segments.tr: Führen Sie es zu oft durch und Sie trainieren Kunden, niemals den vollen Preis zu zahlen.

segments.src: Personal selling** — a human being in a two-way conversation.
segments.tr: Persönlicher Verkauf** — ein Mensch in einem zweiseitigen Gespräch.

segments.src: The salesperson on the floor, the enterprise rep on a call.
segments.tr: Der Verkäufer im Geschäft, der Enterprise-Vertreter bei einem Anruf.

segments.src: Strength: it adapts in real time, handles objections, and closes complicated deals.
segments.tr: Stärke: Sie passt sich in Echtzeit an, handhabt Einwände und schließt komplizierte Geschäfte ab.

segments.src: Weakness: it's by far the most expensive per contact.
segments.tr: Schwäche: Sie ist bei weitem die teuerste pro Kontakt.

segments.src: Most modern textbooks add a fifth: **direct and digital marketing** — email, SMS, targeted social, direct mail — messages aimed at specific known individuals with a response mechanism built in.
segments.tr: Die meisten modernen Lehrbücher fügen ein Fünftes hinzu: **Direkt- und Digitalmarketing** — E-Mail, SMS, gezieltes Social Media, Direktwerbung — Botschaften an bestimmte bekannte Personen mit eingebauter Antwortmöglichkeit.

segments.src: Two ideas tie the toolkit together.
segments.tr: Zwei Ideen verbinden das Toolkit zusammen.

segments.src: **Push vs.
segments.tr: **Push vs.

segments.src: pull.** A *push* strategy aims promotion at the channel: trade discounts and sales reps that get retailers to stock and push your product.
segments.tr: pull.** Eine *Push*-Strategie zielt auf die Förderung des Kanals ab: Handelsrabatte und Verkäufer, die Einzelhandelsgeschäfte dazu bringen, Ihr Produkt zu lagern und zu bewerben.

segments.src: A *pull* strategy aims at the end customer, so they walk in and ask for it by name, and retailers stock it because demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: Eine *Pull*-Strategie zielt auf den Endkunden ab, damit dieser hereinkommt und danach fragt, und Einzelhandelsgeschäfte lagern es, weil die Nachfrage es durchzieht.

segments.src: Most companies run both.
segments.tr: Die meisten Unternehmen führen beide durch.

segments.src: **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC).** Different tools, different budgets, different agencies — but the customer doesn't see departments.
segments.tr: **Integrierte Marketingkommunikation (IMC).** Verschiedene Werkzeuge, verschiedene Budgets, verschiedene Agenturen — aber der Kunde sieht keine Abteilungen.

segments.src: They see one brand.
segments.tr: Er sieht eine Marke.

segments.src: If your ad says "premium craftsmanship" while your email says "70% OFF — TODAY ONLY," you've spent two budgets to confuse one person.
segments.tr: Wenn Ihre Anzeige "Premium-Handwerk" sagt, während Ihre E-Mail "70% RABATT — NUR HEUTE" sagt, haben Sie zwei Budgets ausgegeben, um eine Person zu verwirren.

segments.src: IMC just means coordinating every message so they compound instead of cancel.
segments.tr: IMC bedeutet einfach, jede Botschaft so zu koordinieren, dass sie sich verstärkt, anstatt sich aufzuheben.

segments.src: The mix shifts with what you sell.
segments.tr: Die Mischung ändert sich je nach dem, was Sie verkaufen.

segments.src: Consumer packaged goods — soda, snacks, shampoo — lean heavily on advertising and sales promotion.
segments.tr: Verbrauchsgüter — Limonade, Snacks, Shampoo — stützen sich stark auf Werbung und Verkaufsförderung.

segments.src: Industrial and B2B products — a $400,000 piece of factory equipment — lean on personal selling, because someone has to answer twenty specific questions before a purchase order gets signed.
segments.tr: Industrie- und B2B-Produkte — ein 400.000-Dollar-Stück Fabrikausrüstung — stützen sich auf persönlichen Verkauf, weil jemand zwanzig spezifische Fragen beantworten muss, bevor eine Bestellung unterzeichnet wird.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im alltäglichen Leben

segments.src: Say it's Saturday in Columbus, Ohio, and you need a new mattress.
segments.tr: Sagen wir, es ist Samstag in Columbus, Ohio, und Sie brauchen eine neue Matratze.

segments.src: Over coffee you skip a YouTube ad for Restwell Mattress — but you catch the tagline.
segments.tr: Beim Kaffee überspringen Sie eine YouTube-Anzeige für Restwell Mattress — aber Sie fangen den Slogan auf.

segments.src: **That's advertising.** Paid, controlled, aimed at everyone.
segments.tr: **Das ist Werbung.** Bezahlt, kontrolliert, auf alle abzielend.

segments.src: Scrolling the local news, you see a piece: "Columbus mattress company donates 500 beds to area shelters."
segments.tr: Beim Scrollen durch die lokalen Nachrichten sehen Sie einen Artikel: "Matratzenunternehmen aus Columbus spendet 500 Betten an Obdachlosenunterkünfte in der Region."

segments.src: Nobody paid the *Dispatch* to run that story; the company's PR team pitched it and a reporter thought it was worth covering.
segments.tr: Niemand bezahlte die *Dispatch*, um diese Geschichte zu veröffentlichen; das PR-Team des Unternehmens präsentierte sie und ein Reporter dachte, sie sei der Berichterstattung wert.

segments.src: You trust it more than the ad, precisely because it isn't an ad.
segments.tr: Sie vertrauen ihr mehr als der Anzeige, genau weil sie keine Anzeige ist.

segments.src: **That's PR.**
segments.tr: **Das ist PR.**

segments.src: In your inbox: "Presidents' Day Sale — $300 off any queen set, ends Monday."
segments.tr: In Ihrem Postfach: "Presidents' Day Sale — 300 Dollar Rabatt auf jeden Queen-Set, endet Montag."

segments.src: Nothing about the mattress changed.
segments.tr: Nichts an der Matratze hat sich geändert.

segments.src: What changed is that waiting until April now costs you $300.
segments.tr: Was sich geändert hat, ist, dass Warten bis April Sie jetzt 300 Dollar kostet.

segments.src: **That's sales promotion** — and note the deadline, which is the whole point.
segments.tr: **Das ist Verkaufsförderung** — und beachten Sie die Frist, die der ganze Punkt ist.

segments.src: You drive over.
segments.tr: Sie fahren hin.

segments.src: An employee asks how you sleep, hears "my lower back's been rough," and walks you to three medium-firm models between $899 and $1,400 — then throws in free delivery to close it.
segments.tr: Ein Mitarbeiter fragt, wie Sie schlafen, hört "mein Rücken ist angespannt", und geleitet Sie zu drei mittelfesten Modellen zwischen 899 und 1.400 Dollar — dann wirft kostenlose Lieferung hinzu, um den Kauf abzuschließen.

segments.src: That personalized twenty minutes cost the company far more than the ad impression did, but it's what actually converted the sale.
segments.tr: Diese personalisierten zwanzig Minuten kosten das Unternehmen weit mehr als der Werbeimpression, aber es ist das, was den Verkauf tatsächlich abgeschlossen hat.

segments.src: **That's personal selling.**
segments.tr: **Das ist persönlicher Verkauf.**

segments.src: Four tools, one purchase.
segments.tr: Vier Werkzeuge, ein Kauf.

segments.src: And notice: if the ad had promised luxury while the email screamed clearance and the salesperson pushed the cheapest floor model, you'd have walked out unsure what this brand even is.
segments.tr: Und beachten Sie: Wenn die Anzeige Luxus versprochen hätte, während die E-Mail laut "Räumung" schrie und der Verkäufer das billigste Ausstellungsmodell anpries, würden Sie verwirrt hinausgehen, ohne zu wissen, was diese Marke überhaupt ist.

segments.src: That's the IMC problem in one afternoon.
segments.tr: Das ist das IMC-Problem an einem Nachmittag.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Drei-Zeilen-Zusammenfassung

segments.src: 1. The promotion mix has four classic tools — advertising, PR, sales promotion, and personal selling — plus direct/digital marketing, and each does a different job.
segments.tr: 1. Der Fördermix hat vier klassische Werkzeuge — Werbung, PR, Verkaufsförderung und persönlicher Verkauf — plus Direkt- / Digitalmarketing, und jedes erledigt eine andere Aufgabe.

segments.src: 2. Advertising buys reach, PR earns credibility, sales promotion creates urgency, and personal selling closes complexity — which is why the right mix depends on what you sell and to whom.
segments.tr: 2. Werbung kauft Reichweite, PR verdient Glaubwürdigkeit, Verkaufsförderung schafft Dringlichkeit, und persönlicher Verkauf schließt Komplexität — deshalb hängt die richtige Mischung davon ab, was Sie verkaufen und an wen.

segments.src: 3. Whatever mix you choose, integrate it: one inconsistent message can undo the budgets behind all the others.
segments.tr: 3. Welche Mischung Sie auch wählen, integrieren Sie sie: eine inkonsistente Botschaft kann die Budgets hinter all den anderen zunichte machen.

segments.tr: Khuyến Mãi Bán Hàng** — những khuyến khích ngắn hạn để kích hoạt hành động *ngay bây giờ*.

segments.src: Coupons, BOGO, rebates, limited-time bundles, loyalty points, free samples.
segments.tr: Phiếu giảm giá, BOGO, hoàn tiền, gói hàng có thời hạn, điểm trung thành, mẫu miễn phí.

segments.src: Strength: fast, measurable, great for driving trial.
segments.tr: Ưu điểm: nhanh, có thể đo lường, tuyệt vời để thúc đẩy thử.

segments.src: Weakness: it's borrowed demand.
segments.tr: Nhược điểm: nó là nhu cầu được vay mượn.

segments.src: Run it too often and you train customers to never pay full price.
segments.tr: Chạy nó quá thường xuyên và bạn dạy khách hàng không bao giờ trả giá đầy đủ.

segments.src: Personal selling** — a human being in a two-way conversation.
segments.tr: Bán Hàng Cá Nhân** — một con người trong cuộc trò chuyện hai chiều.

segments.src: The salesperson on the floor, the enterprise rep on a call.
segments.tr: Nhân viên bán hàng trên sàn, đại diện doanh nghiệp trong cuộc gọi.

segments.src: Strength: it adapts in real time, handles objections, and closes complicated deals.
segments.tr: Ưu điểm: nó thích ứng trong thời gian thực, xử lý các phản đối, và đóng các giao dịch phức tạp.

segments.src: Weakness: it's by far the most expensive per contact.
segments.tr: Nhược điểm: nó là đắt nhất theo từng liên hệ.

segments.src: Most modern textbooks add a fifth: **direct and digital marketing** — email, SMS, targeted social, direct mail — messages aimed at specific known individuals with a response mechanism built in.
segments.tr: Hầu hết các sách giáo khoa hiện đại thêm thứ năm: **tiếp thị trực tiếp và kỹ thuật số** — email, SMS, phương tiện truyền thông xã hội được nhắm mục tiêu, thư trực tiếp — tin nhắn nhằm vào các cá nhân cụ thể đã biết với cơ chế phản ứng được tích hợp sẵn.

segments.src: Two ideas tie the toolkit together.
segments.tr: Hai ý tưởng kết nối bộ dụng cụ với nhau.

segments.src: **Push vs.
segments.tr: **Push vs.

segments.src: pull.** A *push* strategy aims promotion at the channel: trade discounts and sales reps that get retailers to stock and push your product.
segments.tr: pull.** Chiến lược *push* nhằm quảng bá vào kênh: chiết khấu thương mại và đại diện bán hàng khiến các nhà bán lẻ dự trữ và đẩy sản phẩm của bạn.

segments.src: A *pull* strategy aims at the end customer, so they walk in and ask for it by name, and retailers stock it because demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: Chiến lược *pull* nhằm vào khách hàng cuối cùng, vì vậy họ đi vào và yêu cầu nó theo tên, và các nhà bán lẻ dự trữ nó vì nhu cầu kéo nó qua.

segments.src: Most companies run both.
segments.tr: Hầu hết các công ty chạy cả hai.

segments.src: **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC).** Different tools, different budgets, different agencies — but the customer doesn't see departments.
segments.tr: **Giao Tiếp Tiếp Thị Tích Hợp (IMC).** Các công cụ khác nhau, ngân sách khác nhau, các cơ quan khác nhau — nhưng khách hàng không nhìn thấy các phòng ban.

segments.src: They see one brand.
segments.tr: Họ nhìn thấy một thương hiệu.

segments.src: If your ad says "premium craftsmanship" while your email says "70% OFF — TODAY ONLY," you've spent two budgets to confuse one person.
segments.tr: Nếu quảng cáo của bạn nói "thủ công cao cấp" trong khi email của bạn nói "GIẢM 70% — CHỈ HÔM NAY," bạn đã chi tiêu hai ngân sách để làm một người bối rối.

segments.src: IMC just means coordinating every message so they compound instead of cancel.
segments.tr: IMC chỉ có nghĩa là phối hợp mọi tin nhắn để chúng tích lũy thay vì hủy bỏ.

segments.src: The mix shifts with what you sell.
segments.tr: Hỗn hợp thay đổi với những gì bạn bán.

segments.src: Consumer packaged goods — soda, snacks, shampoo — lean heavily on advertising and sales promotion.
segments.tr: Hàng hóa tiêu dùng được đóng gói — soda, đồ ăn nhẹ, dầu gội — phụ thuộc nhiều vào quảng cáo và khuyến mãi bán hàng.

segments.src: Industrial and B2B products — a $400,000 piece of factory equipment — lean on personal selling, because someone has to answer twenty specific questions before a purchase order gets signed.
segments.tr: Sản phẩm công nghiệp và B2B — một bộ phận thiết bị nhà máy trị giá $400.000 — phụ thuộc vào bán hàng cá nhân, vì ai đó phải trả lời hai mươi câu hỏi cụ thể trước khi đơn đặt hàng được ký.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Trong Đời Sống Hàng Ngày

segments.src: Say it's Saturday in Columbus, Ohio, and you need a new mattress.
segments.tr: Giả sử đó là thứ Bảy tại Columbus, Ohio, và bạn cần một chiếc nệm mới.

segments.src: Over coffee you skip a YouTube ad for Restwell Mattress — but you catch the tagline.
segments.tr: Uống cà phê bạn bỏ qua quảng cáo YouTube cho Restwell Mattress — nhưng bạn bắt được câu khẩu hiệu.

segments.src: **That's advertising.** Paid, controlled, aimed at everyone.
segments.tr: **Đó là quảng cáo.** Trả tiền, kiểm soát, nhằm vào mọi người.

segments.src: Scrolling the local news, you see a piece: "Columbus mattress company donates 500 beds to area shelters."
segments.tr: Cuộn qua tin tức địa phương, bạn thấy một bài: "Công ty nệm Columbus tặng 500 giường cho các nơi trú ẩn địa phương."

segments.src: Nobody paid the *Dispatch* to run that story; the company's PR team pitched it and a reporter thought it was worth covering.
segments.tr: Không ai trả tiền cho *Dispatch* để chạy câu chuyện đó; đội PR của công ty đã đề xuất nó và một phóng viên nghĩ nó đáng được phủ sóng.

segments.src: You trust it more than the ad, precisely because it isn't an ad.
segments.tr: Bạn tin tưởng nó hơn quảng cáo, chính xác vì nó không phải là quảng cáo.

segments.src: **That's PR.**
segments.tr: **Đó là PR.**

segments.src: In your inbox: "Presidents' Day Sale — $300 off any queen set, ends Monday."
segments.tr: Trong hộp thư của bạn: "Bán Ngày Tổng Thống — Giảm $300 cho bất kỳ bộ queen nào, kết thúc Thứ Hai."

segments.src: Nothing about the mattress changed.
segments.tr: Không có gì thay đổi về chiếc nệm.

segments.src: What changed is that waiting until April now costs you $300.
segments.tr: Những gì thay đổi là chờ đến tháng Tư giờ đây có giá $300.

segments.src: **That's sales promotion** — and note the deadline, which is the whole point.
segments.tr: **Đó là khuyến mãi bán hàng** — và lưu ý thời hạn, đó là toàn bộ điểm.

segments.src: You drive over.
segments.tr: Bạn lái xe đi.

segments.src: An employee asks how you sleep, hears "my lower back's been rough," and walks you to three medium-firm models between $899 and $1,400 — then throws in free delivery to close it.
segments.tr: Một nhân viên hỏi bạn ngủ như thế nào, nghe "lưng dưới của tôi đã khó khăn," và dẫn bạn đến ba mô hình vừa chắc giữa $899 và $1.400 — sau đó tặng giao hàng miễn phí để đóng nó.

segments.src: That personalized twenty minutes cost the company far more than the ad impression did, but it's what actually converted the sale.
segments.tr: Hai mươi phút được cá nhân hóa đó có giá cao hơn nhiều cho công ty so với ấn tượng quảng cáo, nhưng nó là những gì thực sự chuyển đổi bán hàng.

segments.src: **That's personal selling.**
segments.tr: **Đó là bán hàng cá nhân.**

segments.src: Four tools, one purchase.
segments.tr: Bốn công cụ, một mua sắm.

segments.src: And notice: if the ad had promised luxury while the email screamed clearance and the salesperson pushed the cheapest floor model, you'd have walked out unsure what this brand even is.
segments.tr: Và lưu ý: nếu quảng cáo đã hứa hòa lạc trong khi email kêu thoát hàng và nhân viên bán hàng đã đẩy mô hình sàn rẻ nhất, bạn sẽ bỏ đi không chắc thương hiệu này thậm chí là gì.

segments.src: That's the IMC problem in one afternoon.
segments.tr: Đó là vấn đề IMC trong một chiều.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Tóm Tắt Ba Dòng

segments.src: 1. The promotion mix has four classic tools — advertising, PR, sales promotion, and personal selling — plus direct/digital marketing, and each does a different job.
segments.tr: 1. Hỗn hợp quảng bá có bốn công cụ cổ điển — quảng cáo, PR, khuyến mãi bán hàng, và bán hàng cá nhân — cộng với tiếp thị trực tiếp/kỹ thuật số, và mỗi công cụ thực hiện một công việc khác nhau.

segments.src: 2. Advertising buys reach, PR earns credibility, sales promotion creates urgency, and personal selling closes complexity — which is why the right mix depends on what you sell and to whom.
segments.tr: 2. Quảng cáo mua tiếp cận, PR kiếm được độ tin cậy, khuyến mãi bán hàng tạo ra sự gấp gáp, và bán hàng cá nhân đóng độ phức tạp — đó là lý do tại sao hỗn hợp đúng phụ thuộc vào những gì bạn bán và cho ai.

segments.src: 3. Whatever mix you choose, integrate it: one inconsistent message can undo the budgets behind all the others.
segments.tr: 3. Bất kỳ hỗn hợp nào bạn chọn, tích hợp nó: một tin nhắn không nhất quán có thể làm mất các ngân sách đằng sau tất cả các tin khác.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Bài Tự Kiểm Tra

segments.src: **Q1.** A software company sells a $250,000 annual enterprise contract that requires custom setup and sign-off from four executives.
segments.tr: **Q1.** Một công ty phần mềm bán hợp đồng doanh nghiệp hàng năm trị giá $250.000 yêu cầu thiết lập tùy chỉnh và ký duyệt từ bốn nhân viên quản lý.

segments.src: Which promotion tool should carry the most weight?
segments.tr: Công cụ quảng bá nào nên mang nặng nhất?

segments.src: - A) Television advertising
segments.tr: - A) Quảng cáo truyền hình

segments.src: - B) Personal selling
segments.tr: - B) Bán hàng cá nhân

segments.src: - C) Coupons
segments.tr: - C) Phiếu giảm giá

segments.src: - D) Free samples
segments.tr: - D) Mẫu miễn phí

segments.src: **Q2.** True or False — Public relations is essentially free, since you don't pay for the media placement.
segments.tr: **Q2.** Đúng hay Sai — Quan hệ công chúng về cơ bản là miễn phí, vì bạn không trả tiền cho vị trí media.

segments.src: **Q3.** A snack brand offers a deep discount every single month.
segments.tr: **Q3.** Một thương hiệu đồ ăn nhẹ cung cấp một chiết khấu sâu mỗi tháng.

segments.src: What's the most likely long-term risk?
segments.tr: Rủi ro dài hạn có khả năng nhất là gì?

segments.src: - A) Customers learn to wait for the discount and stop paying full price
segments.tr: - A) Khách hàng học cách chờ giảm giá và dừng trả giá đầy đủ

segments.src: - B) The product's manufacturing cost rises
segments.tr: - B) Chi phí sản xuất của sản phẩm tăng

segments.src: - C) Retailers are legally barred from stocking it
segments.tr: - C) Các nhà bán lẻ bị cấm theo pháp luật lưu trữ nó

segments.src: - D) Advertising becomes impossible
segments.tr: - D) Quảng cáo trở nên bất khả thi

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Các Điều Khoản Hôm Nay

segments.src: - **Promotion mix** — the combination of communication tools a company uses to reach and persuade its target market.
segments.tr: - **Hỗn hợp quảng bá** — sự kết hợp các công cụ giao tiếp mà một công ty sử dụng để tiếp cận và thuyết phục thị trường mục tiêu của nó.

segments.src: - **Advertising** — any paid, non-personal form of presentation or promotion by an identified sponsor.
segments.tr: - **Quảng cáo** — bất kỳ hình thức trình bày hoặc quảng bá được trả tiền, không cá nhân nào do một nhà tài trợ được xác định.

segments.src: - **Sales promotion** — a short-term incentive designed to encourage immediate trial or purchase.
segments.tr: - **Khuyến mãi bán hàng** — một khuyến khích ngắn hạn được thiết kế để khuyến khích thử hoặc mua sắm ngay lập tức.

segments.src: - **Push vs. pull strategy** — promoting *to the channel* so it stocks and pushes your product, versus promoting *to end customers* so their demand pulls it through.
segments.tr: - **Chiến lược push vs. pull** — quảng bá *cho kênh* để nó dự trữ và đẩy sản phẩm của bạn, so với quảng bá *cho khách hàng cuối cùng* để nhu cầu của họ kéo nó qua.

segments.src: - **Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC)** — coordinating all promotional channels so the brand delivers one clear, consistent message.
segments.tr: - **Giao Tiếp Tiếp Thị Tích Hợp (IMC)** — phối hợp tất cả các kênh quảng bá để thương hiệu cung cấp một tin nhắn rõ ràng, nhất quán.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** High-value, complex, multi-stakeholder purchases need two-way conversation, objection handling, and customization.
segments.tr: *Câu Trả Lời: **Q1 — B.** Các mua sắm có giá trị cao, phức tạp, nhiều bên liên quan cần cuộc trò chuyện hai chiều, xử lý phản đối, và tùy chỉnh.

segments.src: The cost per contact is high, but the deal size easily justifies it.
segments.tr: Chi phí mỗi liên hệ cao, nhưng kích thước giao dịch dễ dàng chứng minh nó.

segments.src: **Q2 — False.** You don't pay for the placement, but you do pay for PR staff, agencies, events, and time — and unlike advertising, you can't control what actually gets said.
segments.tr: **Q2 — Sai.** Bạn không trả tiền cho vị trí, nhưng bạn trả tiền cho nhân viên PR, các cơ quan, sự kiện, và thời gian — và không giống như quảng cáo, bạn không thể kiểm soát những gì thực sự được nói.

segments.src: **Q3 — A.** Constant discounting reframes the sale price as the real price.
segments.tr: **Q3 — A.** Chiết khấu liên tục khung lại giá bán như là giá thực.

segments.src: Customers simply wait, and the brand's perceived value and margins both erode.*
segments.tr: Khách hàng chỉ đợi, và giá trị nhận thức và lợi nhuận của thương hiệu đều xói mòn.*
